By means of the robot control method and device, the computer readable storage medium and the robot, it can be guaranteed that the mass center is within the supporting range when the robotcarries an object, and the stability of the robot is greatly improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and in particular relates to a robot attitude control method and device, a computer-readable storage medium, and a robot. The method is used forconstructing a virtual model of the robot; the virtual model comprises a flywheel inverted pendulum model of the robot, and an included angle formed by the foot sole surface of the robot and the horizontal plane; and based on the virtual model, the attitude control of the outer loop closed loop feedback, the inner loop external position disturbance resistance, the inner loop external speed disturbance resistance, and the inner loop external force disturbance resistance is performed on the robot. According to the robot attitude control method, the brand-new virtual model is proposed; on the basis of the flywheel inverted pendulum model of the robot, the included angle between the foot sole surface of the robot and the horizontal plane is considered in the virtual model; and the virtual model can fully reflect the posture of the upper body of the robot, the center of mass and the attitude of foot plates, which are critical elements for the balance and attitude control of the robot; theattitude control is performed based on this virtual model; and the virtual model a relatively good control effect and relatively strong robustness.
source_title: Robot attitude control method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a man-machine cooperation system and an operation control method and device.The system comprises a positioner, a robot, a self-adaptive cooperation module and a whole body control module; an end effector of the robot is provided with a force/touch sensor; the force/touch sensor is used for measuring force information applied by the end effector; the positioner is used for measuring motion data of a motion part of the operator; the self-adaptive cooperation module is used for solving the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity of the tail end of the robot based on the motion data and the force information; and the whole body control module is used for solving the joint speed control quantity of the robot based on the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity. According to the technical scheme, the operability of man-machine cooperation for the deformation target object can be improved.
source_title: Man-machine cooperation system, operation control method and device

abstract: The invention provides a method and device for acquiring a centroid trajectory, a robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that an optimization variable is constructed according to N centroid variables of the robot in N control periods and the acceleration change rate of N centroids, a coefficient matrix for solving a zero moment point trajectory is obtained according to the optimization variable and a first preset matrix, according to the coefficient matrix for solving the zero moment point trajectory and an expected zero moment point trajectory, an expression matrix of a cost function of the robot is obtained, an equality constraint condition of the centroid of the robot is obtained, and according to the equality constraint condition and the expression matrix of the cost function, constraint solving is carried out on the optimization variable to obtain a centroid trajectory of the robot. According to the method and the device, the optimization variable constraint is solved by adopting the equality constraint condition, so that the cost function constructed by the solved zero moment point trajectory and the expected zero moment point trajectory is minimum, and the centroid trajectory corresponding to the zero moment point track in any shape can be solved.
source_title: Method and device for acquiring centroid trajectory, robot and storage medium

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for predicting a fall of a robot having at least two legs. A learned representation, such as a decision list, generated by a supervised learning algorithm is received. This learned representation may have been generated based on trajectories of a simulated robot when various forces are applied to the simulated robot. The learned representation takes as inputs a plurality of features of the robot and outputs a classification indicating whether the current state of the robot is balanced or falling. A plurality of features of the current state of the robot, such as the height of the center of mass of the robot, are determined based on current values of a joint angle or joint velocity of the robot. The current state of the robot is classified as being either balanced or falling by evaluating the learned representation with the plurality of features of the current state of the robot.
source_title: Machine learning approach for predicting humanoid robot fall

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic flexible driver based on sarcomels, and belongs to the technical field of soft robots. The driver comprises an external pneumatic artificial muscle driving unit group, an internal bionic stretch-draw integral framework, an upper connecting disc buckle group and a lower connecting disc buckle group. The external pneumatic artificial muscle driving unit set is composed of four external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units distributed in a cross shape and serves as an active driving source. The internal tensioning integral framework achieves self-balance and self-stabilization through prestress. Differential air pressure is applied to all the external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units, the external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units are controlled to generate non-uniform axial contraction, and therefore the whole body is driven to achieve controllable bending movement. According to the flexible actuator, the sarcomedo bionic principle and the tensegrity structure are fused, the rigidity and stability are remarkably improved while good flexibility is kept, the problems that a traditional flexible actuator is low in rigidity, slow in response and insufficient in deformation control precision are effectively solved, and the flexible actuator is suitable for robot operation scenes needing high flexibility and environmental adaptability.
source_title: Bionic flexible driver based on sarcomedo

abstract: A walking pattern preparing device for preparing a walking pattern that enables a parallel-link-mechanism, 2-leg walking robot device to go up/down stairs. The walking pattern preparing device for preparing the walking pattern of a 2-leg walking robot device including legs provided with feet and a waist, comprises a path setting means (212) for setting the paths of right and left feet and the initial path of the waist, and target ZMP path setting means (213) for setting the path of a target zero-moment point based on the paths of the feet and the initial path of the waist, wherein the path setting means sets paths such that, when the robot device goes up stairs, the waist is turned so that an idling foot out of the feet is ahead of the other and the idling foot is lifted and allowed to move forward while kept higher, and when it goes down stairs, the waist is turned so that an idling foot out of the feet is ahead of the other and the idling foot is pushed down to a lower level while allowed to move forward.
source_title: WALKING PATTERN PREPARING DEVICE, 2-LEG WALKING ROBOT DEVICE, WALKING PATTERN PREPARING METHOD, 2-LEG WALKING ROBOT DEVICE CONTROLLING METHOD, PROGRAM AND RECORDING MEDIUM

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device and a robot. The robot control method provided by the invention comprises the steps of performing global path planning on a mobile chassis in a low-dimensional sampling space according to a starting pose of the mobile chassis at a starting point and a target pose of the mobile chassis at a target point, and obtaining a collision-free path of the mobile chassis from the starting point to the target point; the initial pose of the mechanical arm is added to each path point on the collision-free path, and a global whole-body path of the robot is obtained; determining a target path section to be replanned; for the target path section, according to the starting pose of the robot at the starting point of the target path section and the ending pose of the robot at the ending point of the target path section, global path planning is conducted on the robot in the high-dimensional sampling space, and a preferred path of the robot from the starting point to the ending point is obtained; and replacing the target path section by using an optimal path to obtain an optimized global whole-body collision-free path, and controlling the robot by using the global whole-body collision-free path.
source_title: Robot control method and device and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that in the process that a robot carries a load, foot trajectory planning is conducted on the robot, and a foot trajectory planning result of the robot is obtained; determining a zero moment point reference trajectory of the robot according to the foot trajectory planning result; determining an equivalent centroid trajectory according to the zero moment point reference trajectory; wherein the equivalent center of mass is the center of mass which takes the robot and the load as a whole; the mass center track of the robot is determined according to the equivalent mass center track; inverse kinematics solution is conducted according to the mass center track of the robot, and the leg joint poses of the robot are obtained; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg joint poses of the robot. According to the method, the influence generated by the load is fully considered, and the walking stability of the robot is effectively improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: A robot controller controls a robot during a fall to reduce the damage to the robot upon impact. The robot controller causes the robot to achieve a tripod-like posture having three contact points (e.g., two hands and one foot) so that the robot motion in arrested with its center of mass (CoM) high above the ground. This prevents a large impact caused by the transfer of potential energy to kinetic energy during the fall. The optimal locations of the three contacts are learned through a machine learning algorithm.
source_title: Humanoid fall damage reduction

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology for calculating a center-of-gravity track where a ZMP (zero moment point) coincides with a target ZMP even if taking a sinking action in a one-leg grounding phase.

SOLUTION: The legged robot changing the center of gravity into a vertical direction while one leg link is grounded by changing a joint angle, is provided with a means for generating the vertical track of the center of gravity; a means for calculating the horizontal track of the center of gravity based on the generated vertical track of the center of gravity, a trinominal equation obtained by discretizing a ZMP equation, the target ZMP and the horizontal speed of the center of gravity at the start and completion of the vertical track; a means for calculating age-based data of the target value of the joint angle based on the generated vertical track of the center of gravity and the calculated horizontal track of the center of gravity; and a means for rotating a joint based on the calculated age-based data of the target value of the joint angle.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI
source_title: LEGGED ROBOT AND ITS CONTROL METHOD

abstract: PURPOSE: A leg stopper for a robot and a controlling method for the same are provided to stably position a robot by extending a stopper for supporting the robot and to restore to a normal operation. CONSTITUTION: A leg stopper for a robot comprises a stopper device(500), a sensor unit(300), and a control unit. The stopper device is drew from or inserted into a robot foot(F) through a plurality of directions. The sensor unit comprises a plurality of FSR(Force Sensing Resistor)s installed on a robot sole for measuring the load distribution of an area where the robot foot touches the ground. The control unit controls the stopper device by comparing a stable area where the robot foot touches the ground and the position of a ZMP(Zero Moment Point).
source_title: LEG STOPPER FOR ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CON TROLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention provides a multi-module security device and a robot, and relates to the field of security equipment. The problems that most elements of a security system are independently arranged and are difficult to integrate reasonably at present are solved. A magic cube type structure is formed by splicing a plurality of modules, security parts are arranged on side modules and a center module, the relative positions of the security parts are adjusted through rotation of the side modules and the center module around the center of a whole body, and the orientations of the security parts are adjusted according to needs. The multi-module security device comprises a machine frame, corner modules, the side modules and the center module, the magic cube type structure is formed, the sides, facing the outside, of the side modules and the center module are provided with grooves provided with the security parts, three driving mechanisms are arranged in each corner module, the output ends of the three driving mechanisms are attached to the side walls of the three side modules adjacent to the corner module respectively, and the driving mechanisms can drive the modules of the layer or column corresponding to the contacted side module to rotate around the center of a frame.
source_title: Multi-module security device and robot

abstract: According to the present invention, a force measurement system for controlling a posture of a walking robot comprises: a load cell sensor mounted on a foot of a walking robot to measure vertical load by weight of the walking robot during walking of the walking robot; a load end bearing connected to the load cell sensor and removing rotation moment applied to the load cell sensor except the vertical load; and a control unit measuring landing power of the walking robot from data measured by the load cell sensor and calculating a ZMP (zero moment point).
source_title: FORCE MEASUREMENT SYSTEM FOR ATTITUDE CONTROL OF WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses an ankle and foot mechanism for a running and jumping double-foot robot. The ankle and foot mechanism for the running and jumping double-foot robot consists of an ankle joint transmission mechanism and a pelma force detecting mechanism, wherein the ankle joint transmission mechanism comprises an ankle joint motor, a crank, a connecting rod, a shank, an ankle joint rotatingshaft, a sole and a connecting rod shaft; and the pelma force detecting mechanism comprises a first force sensor, a second force sensor, a pelma pad, a heel, a front sole, a guiding column sleeve andfive guiding columns. By the design of a four-bar linkage, the ankle joint motor controls the angle or angular velocity of an ankle joint, by the transmission mechanism, the center of mass of the ankle or shank is raised to a high position, the rotational inertia of the shank is greatly reduced, furthermore, the space of the ankle is saved, the size of feet is reduced, the weight is also reduced,the dynamic response characteristic of whole legs in a swinging process is improved favorably, and the flexibility of movement of the robot is improved.
source_title: Ankle and foot mechanism for running and jumping double-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a complex irregular-shaped workpiece flexible assembly method based on machine vision, and belongs to the technical field of robot assembly. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a 3D point cloud of an assembly workpiece, and obtaining a contour of the 3D point cloud as a template contour of the assembly workpiece; acquiring an RGB-D image of the assembly base based on the depth camera, extracting the contour of an assembly hole of the assembly base by using Canny edge detection, and calculating the position of the center of mass of the assembly hole; a double-stage contour registration method is adopted, the contour of the base assembly hole is matched with the contour of a template of an assembly workpiece, and pre-positioning of the assembly workpiece is achieved; and the assembly robot inserts the assembly workpiece according to the pre-positioned posture and the admittance algorithm through the force signal collected by the force sensor until the assembly is completed. According to the method, visual geometric guidance and a force sense accurate perception model are combined, and flexible assembly of workpieces in complex shapes is achieved according to an admittance control algorithm. The method is high in efficiency and good in safety, and provides reliable technical support for industrial scene application.
source_title: Complex irregular-shaped workpiece flexible assembly method based on machine vision

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot (1) capable of moving on the ground by means of a spherical wheel (2) suitable for rolling on the ground, the robot (1) comprising a trunk (4), at least one arm (5) and an upper part (6), the trunk (4) being connected to the platform (3) and to the upper part (6), characterised in that the robot (1) can move by tilting between a straight position and a tilted position, the trunk (4) of the robot (1) comprising a first portion (40) and a second portion (41), the trunk (4) being configured to maintain the position of the centre of mass (7) of the robot (1) so as to allow the robot (1) to tilt towards the ground.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT HAVING A SPHERICAL WHEEL AND COMPRISING AN ARTICULATED TRUNK

abstract: The invention relates to a high-precision stable control method based on a fire-fighting robot. The method comprises the steps: carrying out decoupling of a mass center and angular momentum of a robot system based on a zero moment point extension method, kinematics and dynamics models, and obtaining a three-dimensional linear model for global dynamic optimization control; based on an overall kinetic model and a kinematic model of the robot system and a boundary stability condition model during cooperative action of a robot platform, constructing a stability criterion of a robot under a specific load working condition, a working environment and a motion track for judging reasonability of a remote control instruction; and analyzing the stability of the robot under a specific remote control instruction in real time according to environmental perception information and information of a robot platform pose part in combination with the boundary stability condition model, and obtaining a reasonable correction strategy of the remote control instruction. According to the stable operation control method based on the fire-fighting robot in an unsteady state environment, boundary stable conditions are constructed, and stable operation of the rescue robot in the complex environment is achieved.
source_title: High-precision stable control method based on fire-fighting robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a search and rescue method through whole body control of a snake-shaped robot based on weight change. The snake-shaped robot according to an aspect of the present invention includes a body part to which a plurality of modules are connected. Based on a change of at least one of a connection point and a separation distance between the plurality of modules, at least one of the length and shape of the body part is changeable. The weight of at least some of the plurality of modules is variable. A predetermined task may be performed based on the changed length of the body part, the changed shape of the body part, and the changed weight of the at least one module.
source_title: Searching and Rescue Method through Snake Robot Whole Body Control Based on Weight Change

abstract: A robot control method includes: obtaining force information associated with a left foot and a right foot of the robot; calculating a zero moment point of a COM of a body of the robot based on the force information; updating a motion trajectory of the robot according to the zero moment point of the COM of the body to obtain an updated position of the COM of the body; performing inverse kinematics analysis on the updated position of the COM of the body to obtain joint angles of a left leg and a right leg of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to the joint angles.
source_title: Robot control method, computer-readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot with bionic muscles, and the robot comprises a robot body which comprises a static fitting area, a movable joint area and a rigid support; the static attaching area is filled with a first composite material composed of a flexible memory telescopic material with a first thickness and an elastic fabric, and the elastic fabric is in filling connection with the static attaching area of the robot body by wrapping the flexible memory telescopic material with the first thickness; a second composite material composed of a flexible memory telescopic material with a second thickness and an elastic fabric is attached to the movable joint area, and the flexible memory telescopic material with the second thickness wraps the movable joint area of the robot body through quilting elastic fabric on the inner side and the outer side. The technical problems that interaction actions and touch feeling with people are stiff, the fineness and flexibility of completing emotion interaction actions are insufficient, and whole-body muscle touch feeling simulation is insufficient are solved.
source_title: Robot with bionic muscles

abstract: The invention discloses a method for a robot to realize whole body compliance by processing a large-area tactile signal, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a tactile signal through a large-area tactile skin array covering the surface of a multi-degree-of-freedom mobile robot, processing and simplifying the signal, and enabling the processed and simplified signal to be equivalent to a six-dimensional resultant force/torque of single-point contact; a separate calculation of the force/moment of each haptic sensing unit is avoided. The resultant force is mapped to all joints of the robot to obtain the joint external torque, then the motion instruction when the robot is stressed is obtained through the assumed robot virtual dynamical model, the whole body compliance behavior of the robot coping with the external force is achieved, and large-range and safe man-machine physical interaction is further achieved.
source_title: Method for achieving whole body compliance by processing large-area tactile signals through robot

abstract: The invention discloses a modular snakelike rescue robot and a control system thereof, and relates to the technical field of snakelike rescue robots, the snakelike rescue robot is formed by connecting six joints in series, each joint has two degrees of freedom, and the snakelike rescue robot has twelve degrees of freedom; each joint assembly is composed of a driving component, a frame connecting piece, a transmission component, a transmission supporting piece, a supporting connecting shaft piece and a joint connecting assembly, and the joint assemblies work cooperatively to enable the joints to achieve two independent rotation freedom degrees. Through the design of high redundancy, the robot has excellent adaptive capacity and lower center of mass, the problem that a traditional robot is difficult to effectively operate in the environment due to huge structure and weight and limited maneuverability and flexibility is solved, and the robot is suitable for detection application in rugged road conditions or narrow spaces.
source_title: Modularized snakelike rescue robot and control system thereof

abstract: A legged mobile robot (R), a legged mobile robot controller (1) and a legged mobile robot control method are provided to perform a loading operation to load a gripped object in parallel on a target place having a height where a stretchable range of arm portions of the legged mobile robot is enhanced with no operator's handling. The legged mobile robot (R) includes the arm portions (R3) having links for gripping an object, and leg portions (R1) having links for moving, and the arm portions (R3) and the leg portions (R1) are joined to a body R2 thereof. The legged mobile robot controller (1) includes a data acquisition unit (3), a whole-body cooperative motion control unit (5) and a loading detection unit (7), and controls motions of the legged mobile robot (R) based on posture/position data regarding a posture/position of each link of the legged mobile robot (R) and on an external force data regarding an external force affecting the arm portions (R3).
source_title: Legged mobile robot and its controller and control method

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, and discloses an exoskeleton robot assisting in operating a high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker, the exoskeleton robot comprises a trunk fixing structure, two arm assemblies and two operating parts, the two arm assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the trunk fixing structure, and the trunk fixing structure comprises a waist and hip bandage and a strap; the arm assembly comprises a supporting rod, a large arm connecting rod and a small arm connecting rod, the lower end of the supporting rod is hinged to the waist and hip bandage, and the operation part is arranged at the end of the small arm connecting rod. The operation part comprises a wrist support and an operation piece, the operation piece is integrated with a rotating end and a push-pull end, the rotating end or the push-pull end can be adjusted to the position facing the handcart circuit breaker, and the auxiliary requirements for different maintenance operations are met. The supporting rod, the large arm connecting rod and the small arm connecting rod form a three-section hinged mode, the improvement purpose of common power generation of the whole body is achieved through cooperative power assistance of the three driving pieces of the waist hip, the shoulder and the elbow, and the effective auxiliary effect is achieved for the operation task of the high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot for assisting operation of high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-legged robot whole-body motion control system and method considering slippage steering, and relates to the technical field of wheel-legged machine control. The system comprises an input module used for receiving an expected motion track or a motion instruction from an upper layer planning system; the trajectory optimization module takes the motion trajectory output by the input module as a tracking target, so that the platform can be optimized in real time along an offline trajectory; the tracking control module is used for solving a joint torque through inverse dynamics by adopting a total rigid body dynamic model, realizing motion tracking through a whole body control WBC method, and solving a motion and contact force priority task by using a hierarchical optimization method; and the state estimation module is used for estimating all current state quantities of model predictive control MPC and information required by whole body control WBC through sensor information. By means of the system, high-dynamic stable motion control over the wheel-legged robot under the complex terrain can be achieved.
source_title: Wheel-legged robot whole-body motion control system and method considering slippage steering

abstract: A method for controlling walking of a robot includes: determining a stance of the robot, in response to the robot being in a single-leg stance, determining a rotational angle of each of the joints, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints; in response to the robot being in a double-leg stance, calculating a position of a projection of a center of mass of the robot on a surface where the robot stands, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints according to the position of the projection; obtaining a feed-forward current of each of the joints; and applying the feed-forward current of each of the joints to a corresponding actuator of this joints.
source_title: Method for controlling walking of robot and robot

abstract: In order to solve the problems that high-altitude operation of building supporting components and trees is difficult, equipment climbing is limited and the like, the invention provides a light double-hand clamping type climbing robot which comprises a clamping manipulator, a rotating mechanism and two supporting arms. The clamping manipulator is composed of a square frame, a four-point clamping mechanism and a single-point clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanisms on the two sides simulate finger bending, the number of wedge-shaped blocks can be adjusted according to different working requirements to change the bending degree, and the four-point clamping mechanism is composed of a quick-release frame and four clamping units and is designed to be a multi-contact clamping face; the single-point clamping mechanism is composed of a quick-release frame and a clamping unit and is designed to be a single-contact clamping face. The two are driven by a motor gear on a square motor and a worm in a matched mode, the automatic locking function is achieved, and the clamping reliability is improved; the rotating mechanism is connected with the square frame and the supporting arm, free rotation of the clamping mechanical arm can be achieved in the climbing process, the climbing capacity is improved, and the climbing robot can move in multiple directions. The double supporting arms are composed of driving mechanisms and hollow frames, turnover type climbing or peristaltic type climbing can be selected according to task requirements and environmental conditions, turnover type climbing is flexible to adapt to different heights and angles, and the climbing efficiency is high; peristaltic climbing simulates biological movement, and stable movement of a complex surface is ensured.
source_title: Light double-hand clamping type climbing robot for columnar object

abstract: A method (1400) of operating a robot (100) includes driving the robot to approach a reach point, extending a manipulator arm (600) forward of the reach point, and maintaining a drive wheel (500) and a center of mass of the robot rearward of the reach point by moving a counter-balance body (300) relative to an inverted pendulum body (200) while extending the manipulator arm forward of the reach point. The robot includes the inverted pendulum body, the counter-balance body deposed on the inverted pendulum body, the manipulator arm connected to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) having a first end (410) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and the drive wheel rotatably coupled to a second end (420) of the at least one leg.
source_title: REACHING MOBILE ROBOTS

abstract: The invention relates to a robot motion control method and device, a robot, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: in response to a motion command, acquiring expected motion information of the robot; acquiring real-time state information of the robot; according to the expected motion information and the real-time state information, control information of the foot ends and control information of whole-body dynamics are determined; and controlling the robot to move according to the control information of the foot ends and the control information of the whole-body dynamics. By adopting the method, the motion control can be more accurately carried out.
source_title: Robot motion control method and device, robot, readable storage medium and program product

abstract: Robotics platforms in accordance with various embodiments of the invention can be utilized to implement highly dexterous robots capable of whole body motion. Robotics platforms in accordance with one embodiment of the invention include: a memory containing a whole body motion application; a spine, where the spine has seven degrees of freedom and comprises a spine actuator and three spine elbow joints that each include two spine joint actuators; at least one limb, where the at least one limb comprises a limb actuator and three limb elbow joints that each include two limb joint actuators; a tracked base; a connecting structure that connects the at least one limb to the spine; a second connecting structure that connects the spine to the tracked base; wherein the processor is configured by the whole body motion application to move the at least one limb and the spine to perform whole body motion.
source_title: Surrogate: a body-dexterous mobile manipulation robot with a tracked base

abstract: A system providing dynamic balancing in a robotic system. The system includes memory storing a definition of a robot and storing an input animation for the robot specifying motion of components of the robot. A simulator performs a dynamic simulation of the robot performing the input animation including modeling a first set of the components as flexible components and a second set of the components as rigid components. Each of the flexible components is coupled at opposite ends to one of the rigid components. An optimizer generates a retargeted motion for the components to provide dynamic balancing of the robot performing the retargeted motion. The optimizer generates the retargeted motion by transforming forces acting on the robot to a local contact frame rigidly moving with the robot. The optimizer generates the retargeted motion so a zero-moment point of the robot lies in a support area of the robot's feet.
source_title: VIBRATION SUPPRESSION AND DYNAMIC BALANCING FOR RETARGETING MOTIONS ONTO ROBOTIC SYSTEMS

abstract: A legged robot that can ensure a large step length while keeping the height of a body trunk at a low position without increasing a moment that is generated due to the gravitational force acting on the trunk and acting on roll joints of legs when standing on one leg is realized. In the legged robot (100), a pair of legs (20R, 20L) is connected so as to be able to rotate around a pitch axis (Y-axis) at lateral surfaces (12) of a trunk (10). Thereby, it is possible to make the height H1 high while keeping the height of the trunk (10) low. It is possible to ensure a large step length while keeping the height of the trunk (10) at a low position. Legs (20) have a structure in which roll joints (38, 42) are positioned below a bottom surface (14). Thereby, the length L1 in the pitch axis direction between the rotation axis C1 of these joints and the center of mass G of the trunk is limited. The moment acting on the roll joints of the grounding leg when standing on one leg is not increased.
source_title: LEGGED ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to a method and a computing system for estimating robot operating parameters. A computing system and a method for estimating friction and/or center of mass (CoM) is presented. The system may perform the method by selecting at least one of (i) a first joint of the plurality of joints, or (ii) a first arm section of the plurality of arm sections. The computing system also outputs a set of one or more movement commands for causing movement of the robotic arm, the movement includes relative movement between the first arm section and the second arm section via the first joint, and receives a set of actuation data and a set of movement data associated with the first joint or the first arm section. The computing system also determines at least one of (i) a friction parameter estimate or (ii) a CoM estimate based on the set of actuation data and the set of movement data.
source_title: Method and computing system for estimating robot operating parameters

abstract: A method (1400) of maneuvering a robot (100) includes driving the robot across a surface (12) and turning the robot by shifting a center of mass of the robot toward a turning direction, thereby leaning the robot into the turning direction. The robot includes an inverted pendulum body (200), a counter-balance body (300) disposed on the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and a drive wheel (500) rotatably coupled to the at least one leg. The inverted pendulum body has first and second end portions (210, 220) and defines a forward drive direction. The method also includes turning the robot by at least one of moving the counter-balance body relative to the inverted pendulum body or altering a height of the at least one leg with respect to the surface.
source_title: MANEUVERING MOBILE ROBOTS

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a whole-body angular momentum matrix of the robot at the current moment; according to the whole-body angular momentum matrix of the robot at the current moment, a robot inverse solution function is constructed, the robot inverse solution function comprises a joint speed cost function, and the joint speed cost function is used for indicating that the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment is smaller than a joint speed threshold value; according to the inverse solution function, the generalized position and the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment are obtained through calculation; according to the generalized position and the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment, motion control is conducted on the robot, by applying the method, the phenomenon that the generalized speed of the robot at any moment is infinite can be avoided through the joint speed cost function, and therefore the robustness of the robot control method can be improved, and compliant control over the robot is achieved.
source_title: Robot control method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a force traction gravity compensation method for an initial value of a force sensor. The force traction gravity compensation method comprises the following steps that multiple groups of six-dimensional force sensor measurement data are obtained when an end execution tool is not subjected to external force and a robot is in different postures; an equation set is established for a fixed value according to the measurement data of the six-dimensional force sensor under different attitudes, an optimal value is solved by using a least square method, and an initial value parameter of the six-dimensional force sensor is solved; according to the initial value parameter of the six-dimensional force sensor, the gravity of the end execution tool, the coordinate of the center of mass of the end execution tool in the six-dimensional force sensor and the initial torque value of the six-dimensional force sensor are obtained; pose transformation of the six-dimensional force sensor coordinate system relative to the robot base coordinate system is solved; and the force and the torque applied to the six-dimensional force sensor by the outside are solved. The force traction gravity compensation method for the initial value of the force sensor is used for effectively performing parameter estimation on tool gravity and realizing tool gravity compensation.
source_title: Force traction gravity compensation method for initial value of force sensor

abstract: The invention discloses a 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method. The method comprises the following steps of step1, giving an expected position of a center of mass and a ZMP position; step2, calculating actual values of the position of the center of mass and the ZMP position respectively; step3, calculating a position error Eercom of the center of mass; step4, when ||Eercom|| is greater than or equal to ||Eerzmp||, executing a step5, and when the ||Eercom|| is less than ||Eerzmp||, returning to the step1; and step5, calculating a correction vector delta q of a joint angle. By using the 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method, a mathematical relationship between the ZMP and the COM (the center of mass) is used to calculate an actual zero point moment so as to acquire a deviation value of the center of mass and a zero moment point; and according to the deviation value, a squat and rise track is optimized and controlled and a deviation is corrected so as to realize stable operation of exoskeleton robot squat and rise motion. A control mode in the invention is simple and high-efficient and is easy to realize.
source_title: 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method

abstract: A robot is provided with a motion control unit. The motion control unit of the robot comprises - a distance computing module calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and outputting - a whole body control module, - a collision avoidance module supplied with an output signal from the distance computing module, - a blending control unit for combining the weighted output control signals of the whole body control module and the collision avoidance control module, wherein the weight of the whole body control output signal is the higher the lower a calculated collision risk, and wherein the weight of the collision avoidance control output signal is the higher the higher the calculated collision risk. The collision avoidance module is designed for - calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and - controlling a collision avoidance action only in the dimension along the connection line between the closest points.
source_title: Robots with collision avoidance functionality

abstract: A service robot includes a wheeled, robotic vehicle and a movable payload platform. A position of the payload platform is controlled to reduce the distance between the center of mass of the service robot and a center of rotation of the vehicle moving along a motion trajectory. Induced centrifugal forces are reduced, allowing for safe operation at higher speeds. In some examples, the payload platform is moved such that the center of mass of the service robot is approximately aligned with the center of rotation of the vehicle. In some embodiments, at least one wheel of the service robot is controlled to maintain a level orientation of the service robot as it traverses uneven terrain. In some embodiments, the service robot includes an inflatable torso structure that allows an upper body robot to bend in a controlled manner to interact with users and a payload loaded onto the payload platform.
source_title: Service robot having movable center of mass

abstract: A method (1400) of operating a robot (100) includes assuming a resting pose (PR) of the robot on a surface (12). The robot includes an inverted pendulum body (200), a counter-balance body (300) disposed on the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one arm (600) connected to the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and a drive wheel (500) rotatably coupled to the at least one leg. The method also includes moving from the resting pose to a sitting pose (PSit) by moving the counter-balance body relative to the inverted pendulum body away from the ground surface to position a center of mass of the robot substantially over the drive wheel.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT SITTING AND STANDING

abstract: A hand apparatus of a robot which is less likely to be damaged and can offer a reliable and effective gripping of a workpiece. The hand apparatus comprises a main frame which is mounted to a wrist member through a plurality of damper couplings. Pivotally mounted to the main frame are a pair of four-point-articulated link arms each having two arms extending parallel to each other. A sub-frame having a finger mounted thereon for pivotal movement in every direction is pivotally mounted to the leading end of the respective link arms. A pair of hydraulic cylinders are provided for moving the link arms in a gripping operation.
source_title: Hand apparatus of a robot

abstract: The invention discloses a visual guidance type omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot and an omnidirectional moving method thereof. The omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot comprises a vehicle body, an upper computer, a supporting framework, a depth camera, a first ultrasonic sensor module, a second ultrasonic sensor module, a third ultrasonic sensor module, a fourth ultrasonic sensor module, a first mechanical arm and a second mechanical arm, wherein the upper computer and the supporting framework are fixed to the vehicle body, the depth camera, the first mechanical arm and the second mechanical arm are arranged on the supporting framework, and the depth camera is electrically connected to the upper computer. The vehicle body comprises a chassis, a vehicle cover, a first direct current motor, a second direct current motor, a third direct current motor, a fourth direct current motor, a first motor drive module, a second motor drive module, a third motor drive module, a fourth motor drive module, a first coupler, a second coupler, a third coupler, a fourth coupler, a first omnidirectional wheel, a second omnidirectional wheel, a third omnidirectional wheel, a fourth omnidirectional wheel, a lower computer and a Bluetooth module. According to the robot and the omnidirectional moving method thereof, the working space range of the robot is expanded, the flexibility of the robot is improved, and the practical value is high.
source_title: Visual guidance type omnidirectional mobile double-arm robot and omnidirectional moving method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a coordination task-oriented master-slave unified admittance control method for a two-arm robot, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a reference coordinate system and a transformation matrix between coordinate systems, and combining closed chain and open chain constraints to obtain a tail end expected movement track and a master-slave arm movement model of the two-arm robot; the resultant force borne by an object is decomposed and introduced into a grabbing matrix, an object dynamic equation in the coordinated movement process is obtained, admittance control is combined, trajectory parameters output by an admittance control algorithm are obtained, and a master-slave unified admittance control UAMSC algorithm is designed; and based on the expected motion trail of the tail end and the master-slave arm motion model, a UAMSC algorithm is applied, and a two-arm robot cooperative control strategy is established and executed for different tasks, so that the stability of the internal force of the system is kept under the conditions of man-machine cooperation and external force interference. According to the method, the requirements of man-machine cooperation and external force interference suppression in coordination task execution of the double-arm robot can be met, and the method can be applied to scenes such as collaborative carrying of the double-arm robot.
source_title: Coordination task-oriented master-slave unified admittance control method for two-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a control method for a magic cube solving robot based on two arms and four fingers, and relates to the field of robot control. According to the method, the step optimization problem of mechanical action recovery of the robot with the two-arm and four-finger structure in the magic cube recovery task can be solved, and the robot can be allowed to perform the mechanical action recovery task on any magic cube in a disordered state. When a task is completed, firstly, a key operation surface and an operation stage are defined, then conversion logic from the magic cube restoration step to the mechanical execution step is constructed, and an optimal restoration path is explored by integrating reset and adjustment stages of adjacent steps and utilizing symmetric plane conversion and selection of an execution strategy. Thirdly, a pruning function is introduced, future step cost is predicted based on historical data, and search space complexity is reduced; and finally, the optimization function is integrated into a search algorithm, a reduction sequence with the least mechanical step number is searched, and the reduction sequence is accurately executed by a controller so as to efficiently and accurately complete the magic cube recovery task.
source_title: Rubik cube solving robot control method based on two arms and four fingers

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of a robot, and in particular to a double-arm-cooperative robot. The double-arm-cooperative robot comprises a binocular vision component, an integrated control cabinet, a double-arm component and a movable platform; a power module, a control module, a communication module, a brake module, a main board and a rigid disc are arranged inside the integrated control cabinet; the binocular vision component comprises at least two cameras which are used for acquiring image information; the cameras are connected with a head vision board card; and the head vision board card is connected with the main board and is used for acquiring the image information and calculating three-dimensional geometrical information. The double-arm-cooperative robot provided by the invention is high in acquisition speed, accurate in location, simple and convenient to operate by virtue of more-anthropopathic setting and capable of improving the accuracy and flexibility of the action of double arms and greatly improving the performances of the robot.
source_title: Double-arm-cooperative robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of double-arm base optimization, in particular to a double-arm robot layout optimization method based on teaching learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, recording teaching; step 2, DMP learning; 3, selecting a common track end point and generalizing the track; 4, selecting an expected layout mode; 5, designing a robot layout measurement index; step 6, optimizing an undetermined layout according to the indexes; 7, adjusting learning algorithm parameters, and generalizing a task track which is faster to execute; according to the double-arm robot platform layout optimization selection method, double-arm robot platform layout optimization selection can be accelerated, the task execution efficiency can be improved for a set task, and service faces double-arm platform construction of the set task.
source_title: Double-arm robot layout optimization method based on teaching learning

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm robot remote real-time control system and method based on virtual reality, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical arm teleoperation. The system comprises virtual reality equipment used for completing interaction between a human body and the double-arm robot, a simulation system of the virtual reality equipment, a video collection system used for collecting images of the double-arm robot, the double-arm robot, a computer and a software control subsystem. The method comprises the steps of experimental area planning, arm posture collection and experimental platform design, posture information transmission, control program design of the double-arm robot, virtual reality picture display and the like. The virtual reality technology is introduced into control of the mechanical arm, compared with a traditional control mode of an operating lever and a control panel, the control mode is faster and simpler. Meanwhile, the movement video of the double-arm robot is fed back to the virtual reality equipment in real time, an inexperienced operator is quite facilitated, a better man-machine interaction mode is achieved. The system is safer.
source_title: Double-arm robot remote real-time control system and method based on virtual reality

abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm robot multi-topological-structure workpiece sorting method based on grabbing prediction, and the method comprises the following steps: a robot controller sends an instruction, and reads an RGB-D image from a robot visual system; dividing the RGB-D image into an RGB image and a depth image, and performing standardization processing on the RGB image and the depth image; constructing a grabbing prediction dual-channel neural network and initializing network parameters; constructing a workpiece data set required by network training; respectively taking the RGB image and the depth image after standardization processing as input of a capture prediction dual-channel neural network; the grabbing prediction dual-channel neural network outputs the grabbable position of the workpiece; the grabbable position of the workpiece is converted from a camera coordinate system to a mechanical arm coordinate system; and the robot controller sends an instruction, the workpiece is grabbed according to the grabbable position, converted to the mechanical arm coordinate system, of the workpiece through a multi-process double-mechanical-arm cooperative grabbing control method, the workpiece is placed in a designated area, and sorting is completed. According to the invention, accurate sorting of various workpieces with different topological structures can be realized.
source_title: Double-arm robot multi-topological-structure workpiece sorting method based on grabbing prediction

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, provides a double-arm robot control method, device and equipment and a medium, can be applied to financial and medical health care service scenes, and can utilize multiple types of sensors to collect current environment data so as to train a visual language action model, so that the model preliminarily has basic generalization ability; a feature extraction module of a double-arm robot action decision model is utilized to dynamically extract multi-modal features of real-time environment information based on an attention mechanism, so that multi-modal feature representation adapting to a dynamic environment is quickly captured, the perceptibility of the model to a new environment is improved, and the generalization ability of the model is improved; and inputting the task target, the constraint condition and the multi-modal features obtained through analysis into a strategy network of the double-arm robot action decision model to obtain an action sequence of the double-arm robot, and controlling the double-arm robot to execute the action sequence so as to realize accurate understanding and decision making of tasks in a new environment, and improve the adaptability of the model to the new environment.
source_title: Double-arm robot control method, device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a heavy-load double-arm industrial robot which is characterized in that a first-shaft assembly body is connected with a rotating seat, two large arms which are arranged left and right at an interval are connected between a second-shaft assembly body and a third-shaft assembly body, and a nitrogen cylinder is connected between each large arm and the rotating seat; the rear side of the three-shaft assembly is connected with a pull rod, the lower end of the pull rod is connected with a pull rod connecting shaft, the left end and the right end of the pull rod connecting shaft are connected with a first balance supporting plate and a second balance supporting plate respectively, and the front ends of the first balance supporting plate and the second balance supporting plate are connected to the lower ends of the two large arms respectively. The rear end of the first balance supporting plate and the rear end of the second balance supporting plate are both connected with balance load blocks, the three-axis assembly body is connected with a three-axis motor, and the two-axis assembly body comprises a two-axis motor, a first speed reducer and a second speed reducer. The first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are connected in series in a transmission mode, the two large arms are connected to the output mounting face of the first speed reducer and the output mounting face of the second speed reducer respectively, and single-motor driving and double-speed-reducer series transmission are achieved.
source_title: Heavy-load double-arm industrial robot

abstract: The invention discloses a path planning method and device for a double-arm robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Comprising the steps that first environment state information and equipment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot are input into a double-arm cooperative control model, and first control data of the double-arm robot are obtained; inputting the first control data, the first position information and the first environment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot into a path planning decision model to obtain a first path; under the condition that the judgment result of the first path is that the target operation requirement is not met, second control data output by the two-arm cooperative control model is obtained; and inputting second control data, second position information and second environment state information corresponding to the double-arm robot into the path planning decision model to obtain a second path, and performing operation demand judgment on the second path again until a target path meeting the target operation demand is obtained. The path planning efficiency and coordination are improved by constructing a closed-loop path planning and motion control coupling mechanism.
source_title: Path planning method and device of double-arm robot, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a preschool education robot with a circuit protecting function. The preschool education robot with the circuit protecting function comprises a body, a head, a chassis, two armsand a drawer; the head is arranged above the body; the chassis is arranged at the bottom of the body; the two arms are positioned on the two sides of the body; the drawer is arranged in the body; a first movement device is arranged between the body and the head; a display and a camera area arranged on the head; a circuit board is arranged in the head; a single chip microcomputer and a power supply module are arranged on the circuit board; the display, the camera and the power supply module are all connected with the single chip microcomputer; and the power supply module comprises a first direct-current power supply, a first resistor, a first capacitor, a three-terminal voltage regulator, a second capacitor, an eighth resistor, a second resistor, a ninth resistor, a first triode, a fifth resistor, a second triode, a third resistor, an integrated operational amplifier, a fourth resistor, a third capacitor, a sixth resistor, a seventh resistor and a second direct-current power supply. The preschool education robot with the circuit protecting function is simple in circuit structure, low in cost and convenient to maintain; and the safety and the reliability of the circuit are high.
source_title: Preschool education robot with circuit protecting function

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-base station laser tracker collaborative re-location double-arm robot testing method and device. The method comprises the following steps that target point space coordinates are acquired; an expression of after-location point coordinates is obtained according to before-re-location point coordinates; a linear EIV mode is Constructed; a Lagrange extremum condition expression is constructed according to the linear EIV model; and a partial derivative is calculated for all components in the Lagrange extremum condition expression, a current to-be-calculated parametervector is obtained by taking the partial derivative as zero, the current to-be-calculated parameter vector is taken as an initial to-be-calculated parameter vector and returning and executing the stepfour are performed, a final to-be-calculated parameter vector is output until the difference between the current to-be-calculated parameter vector and a to-be-calculated parameter vector obtained inthe last iteration is less than a preset value, and the after-location point coordinates are obtained according to the final to-be-calculated parameter vector. The method has the advantage that coordinate systems of a multi-base station laser tracker are unified by the laser tracker collaborative re-location method.
source_title: Multi-base station laser tracker collaborative re-location double-arm robot testing method and device

abstract: The present invention relates to a workability analysis method of a two-arm robot. The purpose of the present invention is to select an initial angle of an arm and an interval of both arms that have optimal workability in a hydraulic driven two-arm robot with a limited range of joint motion of robot arms, and to compare workability of two-arm robots with different joint arrangements and link lengths of robot arms. To this end, the workability analysis method of a two-arm robot comprises the following steps of: (a) calculating the volume (V_total) of the entire working space of both arms (S10); (b) calculating the volume (V_common) of an area in which a working space of each arm overlaps (S20); (c) calculating PTCWA by the V_total calculated in the step S10 and the V_common calculated in the step S20 (S30); (d) selecting an initial angle of an arm and an interval of both arms that have optimal workability by the PTCWA calculated in the step S30 (S40); (e) calculating the effective length L of robot arms (S50); (f) calculating a performance index Q by the PTCWA calculated in the step S30 and the effective length L of the robot arms calculated in the step S50 (S60); and (g) comparing performances of two-arm robots with different joint arrangements and link lengths by the performance index Q calculated in the step S60 (S70).
source_title: Workability Analysis Method of Two Arm Robot and Robot Having Two Arms Using the Same

abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To minimize a footprint when a hand is reversed, to prevent a rise of circuit board path line and furthermore to enable easy application even to a double-arm robot. SOLUTION: A driving device of robot hand 6 is the driving device for a movable robot hand 6 that holds a thin circuit board (glass circuit board 8) and has a reversing mechanism 7 that rotates the robot hand 6 around the horizontal axis 9 that is orthogonal with the hand longitudinal direction.
source_title: Driving gear of manipulator

abstract: The present invention introduces a robot gripper and a control method thereof. The robot gripper comprises: upper and lower contact parts arranged on the end of both robot arms, coming in contact with the top and bottom surfaces of a weight in gripping, and formed as a spherical shape with the constant radius; sensor parts arranged in the upper and lower contact parts to measure vertical or horizontal pressing force applied to the upper or lower contact part in gripping; and a control part for obtaining the barycentric coordinates of the weight using the vertical and horizontal distance between the end of the both arms when the weight is gripped, the vertical and horizontal pressing force components measured by the sensor parts, and the height of the weight. [Reference numerals] (700) Control part
source_title: GRIPPPER OF ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a novel mobile type double-arm robot. The novel mobile type double-arm robot includes wheel type chassis (1), supporting frames (2), a vehicle body movement assembly (3), electric driving body rotation assemblies (4), hydraulic leg lifting assemblies (2), a vehicle body (6); two wheel type chassis (1) are provided and are mounted at the bottom of the vehicle body movement assembly (3); the vehicle body (6) is mounted on the vehicle body movement assembly (3), so that the vehicle body (6) can move on the vehicle body movement assembly (3); and the vehicle body (6) is provided with a visual information collection device (7) and robot arm assemblies (8). The novel mobile type double-arm robot of the invention integrates the advantage of high speed of a fast wheel-type device and the advantage of obstacle surmounting ability of a leg-type device and can quickly enter a dangerous area. The novel mobile type double-arm robot, based on the vehicle body movement assembly and the double six-degree-of-freedom manipulators, can replace workers to perform complicated task. The operation space of the novel mobile type double-arm robot is large; and the work ability of the novel mobile type double-arm robot is strong.
source_title: Novel mobile type double-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent robot practical training platform for solving a magic cube, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The intelligent robot practical training platform for solving the magic cube comprises a mounting table, a double-arm cooperation robot, a camera mechanism and two magic cube placing bases, wherein an electrical element and a control system areinstalled below the mounting table; the double-arm cooperation robot comprises a robot mounting frame, a double-arm cooperation robot body and two tail end grabbing arms, the robot mounting frame isinstalled on the mounting table, the robot mounting frame is of a hollow tubular structure, and the inner of the robot mounting frame is used for wiring; two movable arms of the double-arm cooperationrobot body are symmetrically installed on the robot mounting frame, and the two tail end grabbing arms are symmetrically installed on two output ends of the double-arm cooperation robot body; the camera mechanism is installed at the upper end of the robot mounting frame, the two magic cube placing bases are installed on the upper end face of the mounting table, and the two-arm cooperation robot body is of two six-axis series-connection robots with the same structure; and the six-axis series-connection robots are modular robots. According to the intelligent robot practical training platform, the magic cube can be solved and the adaptability is relatively high.
source_title: Intelligent robot practical training platform for solving magic cube

abstract: PURPOSE: To perform an exact follow-up operation in a double-arm robot in which a slave robot performs a follow-up operation for a main robot. CONSTITUTION: A main robot control part 44 outputs target location data from a data transmission part 15 to the data reception part 25 of a slave robot control part 55. The slave robot control part 55 receives target location data In an offset amount addition part 27, prescribed offset amount is added to target location data. Based on the added data, a slave robot is made to perform the follow-up operation for a main robot. At this time, the processing start of target location data is delayed in the delay processing part 41 of a main robot control part 44. Subsequently, the processing of an interpolation part 12 is started in timing with the processing start in the interpolation processing part 22 of the slave robot.
source_title: DOUBLE-ARM ROBOT CONTROLLER

abstract: The invention discloses a dual-arm apple picking and round classified collecting robot which comprises an autonomous movable platform. A robot body is installed at the center of the upper portion of the autonomous movable platform. A binocular vision sensor mechanism is installed on the top of the robot body. A fruit conveying and classified collecting system matched with the robot body is arranged on the front side of the robot body. A storage battery pack is arranged on the autonomous movable platform. A central controller is installed at the upper portion of the storage battery pack. The storage battery pack provides power for all motors and sensors and a central control unit on the robot body and the autonomous movable platform. The central control unit is the control center of the whole robot and controls all the electrical apparatus elements to work. The robot is high in adaptability, flexible in movement, safe, reliable and compact in structure and has the apple picking and classified collecting capacity.
source_title: Dual-arm apple picking and round classified collecting robot

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm manipulator device integrated with multiple sensors and a cooperative compliant operation method of the double-arm manipulator device. The double-arm manipulator device comprises the multiple sensors, a control circuit and a robot. The control circuit is arranged on the robot; the robot comprises a robot gripper; the multiple sensors are arranged on fingers of the robot gripper and simulate the touch sensing function of the fingers of a person; the multiple sensors sense a target object to obtain touch sensing information; and the control circuit controls the robot fingers to output preset force according to the touch sensing information so as to carry out smooth operation on the target object. According to the double-arm robot arm device, the human body structure is designed in a bionic mode, the fingers are integrated with multiple flexible sensors, the touch sensing function that the fingers of a person sense pressure and temperature can be simulated, and real-time feedback is achieved in the operation process.
source_title: Double-arm manipulator device integrated with multiple sensors and collaborative compliant operation method of double-arm manipulator device

abstract: The invention discloses a selling double-arm robot which comprises a robot body, a control device arranged in the robot body, selling operation double arms connected with the robot body and selling tail end executers arranged at the tail ends of the operation double arms. The control device controls the selling operation double arms and the selling tail end executers to execute selling operation.The invention further discloses an automatic selling system which comprises the selling double-arm robot and a selling square bin, and selling equipment is arranged in the selling square bin. The selling double-arm robot operates the selling equipment to execute the selling operation. By means of the selling double-arm robot, the selling operation double arms are adopted for executing the sellingaction correspondingly, a double arm cooperative operation manner in a complex selling scene is achieved, the selling double-arm robot is suitable for operation of different pieces of selling equipment, flexibility of the operation of selling diversified goods is improved, and the requirements of diversified selling scenes are met.
source_title: Selling double-arm robot and automatic selling system

abstract: The invention relates to a high-adaptability double-arm heavy-load operation robot. A mechanical arm control device comprises a hydraulic mechanical arm, a mechanical arm supporting piece, a hydraulic driving system, a pump station shell and two circular rotating tables. The crawler leg wheel control device comprises a crawler leg composite walking mechanism, an auxiliary wheel supporting mechanism and triangular crawler wheels, the crawler leg composite walking mechanism comprises walking hydraulic cylinders hinged to the four corners of the chassis mechanism and a bridge plate, and a hinge connector with the free end hinged to a piston rod of the corresponding walking hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the bent position of the middle of the bridge plate. A steering mechanism is fixedly connected to the bridge plate connecting piece, and a walking motor is fixedly installed on the side, facing the triangular crawler wheels, of the steering mechanism. The auxiliary wheel supporting mechanism comprises a supporting piece fixed to the lower portion of the chassis mechanism, a supporting hydraulic cylinder with the two ends hinged to the supporting piece and an auxiliary wheel rotationally connected to the bottom of the supporting piece. The problems that in the obstacle crossing or step climbing process of an existing heavy-load operation robot, operability is not high, and reliability is not high are solved.
source_title: High-adaptability double-arm heavy-load operation robot

abstract: The invention discloses a method and equipment for controlling a double-arm robot to automatically grind crystal materials and a medium, belongs to the field of experiments for controlling robots to make crystal materials, and is used for a double-arm robot grinding system.The method comprises the steps that 1, the double-arm robot is controlled to move to a grinding platform, and a camera is used for obtaining mortar pose information to locate the position of a mortar; step 2, acquiring a color distribution image of a crystal in the mortar by using a camera to judge subsequent operation, and if the grinding is judged to be stopped, executing step 5; if the operation is determined to be gathering operation, executing the step 3, and if the operation is determined to be grinding operation, executing the step 4; 3, a slave arm of the double-arm robot is controlled to gather the crystals in the mortar, and the step 2 is executed after gathering operation is finished; 4, a slave arm of the double-arm robot is controlled to fix the mortar, a main arm conducts grinding operation on the crystals in the mortar, and the step 2 is executed after grinding operation is finished; and 5, the double-arm robot is controlled to stop the grinding task. According to the method, the crystal grinding efficiency and accuracy can be improved.
source_title: Method and equipment for controlling double-arm robot to automatically grind crystal material and medium

abstract: The invention provides a double-arm magic cube solving robot and a restoring method thereof. The double-arm magic cube solving robot is mainly composed of magic cube solving mechanical arms, a robot body mechanism, an end effector and a control box attached to a robot body. Each mechanical arm main body part is mainly composed of a closed-loop stepping motor, a coupler, an air slip ring, a zero setting code disc and a U-shaped photoelectric switch. Through an upper computer control program programmed based on Python, a plurality of cameras and a magic cube regularly rotated by the mechanical arms are adopted for color collection, Euclidean distance and edge detection are adopted, six colors of the six faces of the magic cube are accurately recognized, and Gamma nonlinear correction is used to reduce exposure and improve brightness. According to the magic cube solving robot technology, a high-quality preliminary embedded talent can be cultivated through complete set of mechanical structure design, circuit design and manufacturing and program design control. Various technologies, especially color recognition, can be applied to various industrial and agricultural activities such as part detection, food quality detection and crop picking.
source_title: Double-arm magic cube solving robot and restoring method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a robot capable of linearly and radially stretching and retracting, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a machine base, a large arm and a second arm, wherein the machine base is of a concave structure, a mounting groove is formed in the upper surface of the machine base, a first motor is fixedly arranged on the inner bottom surface of the machine base, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating synchronous wheel through a coupler, and the first rotating synchronous wheel is located in the mounting groove. According to the robot, the large arm and the machine base are connected through a rotating shaft, the large arm and the second arm are connected through a further rotating shaft and driven by one motor through a synchronous wheel and a synchronous belt, the large arm is arranged on a bearing of the machine base and is driven by another motor to complete a plane joint type robot which rotates around the center of the base, the two arms are driven to rotate at the same time through the rotation of one motor and the connection of the synchronous belt and thesynchronous wheel, the length and the transmission ratio of the two arms only need to meet a certain motion relation, and then any linear motion of an end effector in the working space of the end effector at the rotating center can be realized.
source_title: Robot capable of linearly and radially stretching and retracting

abstract: The invention provides an end effector for carrying wafers, a double-arm robot and a four-arm robot. A wafer upper mounting groove and a wafer lower mounting groove are formed in the top surface and the bottom surface of an effector main body respectively; and the wafer upper mounting groove and the wafer lower mounting groove are symmetrically distributed up and down relative to the thickness center line of the actuator main body, so that the end actuator used for carrying the wafer can be universally used on left and right mechanical arms without being limited by a double-cavity structure of equipment, and unified manufacturing and unified maintenance of the end actuator are facilitated.
source_title: End effector for conveying wafer, double-arm robot and four-arm robot

abstract: The invention relates to a width-adjustable armpit supporting flexible double arm structure used for a nursing robot.
