The heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton comprises a back part, a waist part, a left leg, a right leg and foot parts, wherein the back part is connected with the waist part; the two sides of the waist part are separately connected with the left leg and the right leg; the left leg and the right leg are connected with the corresponding foot parts; the waist part is rotatably connected with the back part; each of the left leg and the right leg comprises an ankle joint and two sets of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures; the two sets of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures are separately arranged at the two ends of the waist part; each set of flexion and extension swing telescopic structures comprises hip joint flexion and extension swing telescopic mechanisms and series-parallel connection telescopic mechanisms; and each hip joint flexion and extension swing telescopic mechanism is mounted on the waist part, and can rotate front and back relative to the waist part. The heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton is used for an exoskeleton robot.
source_title: Heavy-load under-actuated parallel lower-limb assisting exoskeleton with elastic buffer

abstract: The invention provides a single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton, and relates to the technical field of robots, the single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton comprises a waist fixing mechanism, a power driving mechanism, a leg assisting mechanism and a control mechanism electrically connected with the power driving mechanism; the waist fixing mechanism is used for adjusting the waistline to be tightly attached to the human waist in the circumferential direction. The leg assisting mechanism comprises a first leg assisting part and a second leg assisting part which are symmetrically arranged along the central axis of the power driving mechanism, one end of each of the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part is in transmission connection with the power driving mechanism, and the other end of each of the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part is fixedly connected with a human leg; the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the horizontal relative distance between the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part; the power driving mechanism is located on the outer side of the right rear portion of the waist fixing mechanism, fixedly and detachably connected with the waist fixing mechanism and used for driving the first leg assisting part and the second leg assisting part to alternately swing in a reciprocating mode and assisting walking of the legs of the human body.
source_title: Single-motor hip bone joint exoskeleton

abstract: The present invention provides a machine learning-based wearable robot control apparatus and system, capable of precisely controlling a wearable robot by more accurately detecting a user motion by giving a weight to motion data of a user affecting the classification of behavior classes. The machine learning-based wearable robot control apparatus according to the present invention comprises: a machine learning unit for learning training data collected by a plurality of behavior classes through machine learning to obtain and store first motion data; a motion information acquisition unit for acquiring second motion data for a user motion through at least two sensors; a motion prediction unit for predicting a behavior class of the user motion corresponding to the second motion data on the basis of one or more acceleration values and angular speed values used by machine learning to generate the first motion data when the first motion data and the second motion data are compared and matched in a matching standard; and a control command generation unit for extracting a control command for controlling a user wearing robot pre-mapped to the behavior classes.
source_title: DEVICE AND SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING WEARABLE ROBOT BASED ON MACHINE LEARNING

abstract: The invention relates to an upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot which comprises a back plate and two power-assisted mechanisms. The two power-assisted mechanisms are distributed at the left end and the right end of the back plate respectively. The power assisting mechanism comprises a shoulder sliding assembly, a driving assembly and an arm transmission assembly. The shoulder sliding assembly comprises a sliding rail, a sliding block and a connecting piece. And the sliding rail is arranged on the back plate. The sliding block is arranged on the sliding rail in a sliding mode and can slide in the left-right direction. The connecting piece is arranged on the sliding block. The driving assembly comprises a mounting part, a driving motor and an output part. The driving motor is arranged in the mounting component, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected to the arm transmission assembly through the output component. The installation part is hinged to the connecting piece, and the hinged axis is vertical. The arm transmission assembly is connected to the output component and can be connected with the upper limbs of the user so as to assist the user in lifting under the driving of the driving motor. When the exoskeleton robot is used, the smoothness and comfort are high.
source_title: Upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: Robotic exoskeleton with self-adjusting sliding elbow support for human arm. The invention relates to a robotic exoskeleton that allows the user to move comfortably and perform medical therapies, assisted orthotic forces, activities related to sports practices or specialized training that require sequences of movements, daily tasks, or services of firemen, police, military, etc. Assisted in force by the exo-skeleton. The system consists of a vest (1), to which are attached the exo-arm (8), the exo-forearm (7), a support structure (2, 3, 4, 5), with sliding parts (5)., 31) and hinges (10) actuated, which allows to track the displacements of the shoulder with respect to the body and offers a solid mobile support point in addition to a passive weight compensation system using spindles (22), with power actuators (9) that allow to move the articulated arm in a controlled manner. The device also comprises an autonomous power supply system (11) and a control unit. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
source_title: Robotic exoskeleton with self-adjusting sliding elbow support for human arm (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

abstract: Disclosed is an ankle joint system having an impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism, wherein the ankle joint system supports ankle muscular strength and absorbs an impact at the same time. The ankle joint system of a wearable robot has the impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism and is operated by one or more of a pitch degree of freedom, a yaw degree of freedom, and a roll degree of freedom. The ankle joint system comprises a foot plate unit, a floor plate, a support unit, an ankle link, an ankle assembly unit, and a rolling hinge.
source_title: Angle joint assembly of Wearable robot

abstract: The invention discloses a head joint of a power-assisted exoskeleton robot and the power-assisted exoskeleton robot. The head joint is mounted on a base of the power-assisted exoskeleton robot and comprises an external mounting bracket and an electric supporting assembly, wherein the supporting assembly is arranged between the external mounting bracket and the base, and the electric supporting assembly is provided with a plurality of moving shafts and can drive the external mounting bracket to do multi-axis motion. The head joint further comprises a follow-up controller, and the follow-up controller is electrically connected with the electric supporting assembly to control the electric supporting assembly to operate so that the external mounting bracket can move along with the head of a user. According to the head joint of the power-assisted exoskeleton robot and the power-assisted exoskeleton robot, by arranging the external mounting bracket and the electric supporting assembly, the user can mount a load or an external device to the external mounting bracket, the electric supporting assembly provides auxiliary supporting force for the external mounting bracket, thus the load borneby the head of the user is greatly reduced or the head of the user does not need to bear an extra load, and the head burden of the user is greatly relieved.
source_title: Head joint of power-assisted exoskeleton robot and power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: An improved robotic contractile device having, besides general industrial and other-wages applicability for automation and other purposes, particularly attractive utility in and for prosthetic appliances and which is characterizable in being able to function in a way remarkably analogous to that of biological muscle is structurally made up of an expandable conduit which is contractible on fluid inflation with a plurality of longitudinally-directed filaments peripherally-secured thereabout that are connectable with an object to be moved or displaced as a result of the contractability experienced upon inflation of said conduit; there being associated means in the device for introducing and exhausting fluid under pressure to the interior of the said conduit in order to inflate same to effectuate its motive contraction action and deflate it to its normal rest condition of maximum or intermediate extension. The way of using the device takes advantage of the cooperative interaction of its constructional components and means.
source_title: Robotic fluid-actuated muscle analogue

abstract: Disclosed is an electronic device. The electronic device comprises: a communication interface; and one or more processors that obtain safety template information including different types of a plurality of pieces of context information, dangerous situation information mapped to each of the plurality of pieces of context information, and control information mapped to each dangerous situation, when at least one piece of sensing data is received from at least one user device through the communication interface, identify context information corresponding to the at least one piece of sensing data, identify dangerous situation information on the basis of the safety template information and the type of context information, identify whether a surrounding environment of a wearable robot corresponds to a dangerous situation corresponding to the identified dangerous situation information on the basis of the at least one piece of sensing data, when it is identified that the surrounding environment corresponds to the dangerous situation, obtain at least one piece of control information mapped to the dangerous situation on the basis of a safety template, and control the wearable robot or at least one of user devices on the basis of the obtained at least one piece of control information.
source_title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR PERFORMING SAFETY FUNCTION AND CONTROL METHOD THEREFOR

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an electromyographic signal classification method, an exoskeleton robot control method and an electromyographic signal classification device. The electromyographic signal classification method comprises the steps that an electromyographic signal is acquired, and active segment of the electromyographic signal is segmented by adopting a plurality of sliding windows with different lengths, so that a plurality of sub-signal segments corresponding to the active segment are obtained, and feature extraction is performed on the sub-signal segments, the featuresof the sub-signal segments are combined to obtain a first feature corresponding to the active segment, dimensionality reduction processing is performed on the first feature to obtain a second feature, and then the second feature is input into a pre-trained classifier to enable the classifier to output the type of the electromyographic signal. In the scheme, the plurality of sliding windows with different lengths are adopted to segment the active segment, the active segment is divided into the plurality of sub-signal segments with different lengths, and the features obtained by performing feature extraction on the multi-length sub-signal segments are more comprehensive and accurate than features obtained by performing feature extraction on single-length signal segments, so that the classification result is more accurate.
source_title: Electromyographic signal classification method, exoskeleton robot control method and electromyographic signal classification device

abstract: A hip joint exoskeleton robot belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a waist binding piece, leg binding pieces, driving mechanisms and executing mechanisms, the two driving mechanisms are installed on the front portion of the waist binding piece, and the executing mechanisms are installed on the two sides of the waist binding piece respectively; each driving mechanism controls the corresponding executing mechanism through a steel wire rope arranged in the Bowden cable pipe. Each actuating mechanism comprises a shell, an outer connecting disc, a rope wheel, a connecting plate and two transition wheels; the connecting plate is rotationally connected with the waist binding piece; the rope wheel and the two transition wheels are rotatably arranged on the same side face of the connecting plate respectively, the two transition wheels are connected into a whole, the outer connecting disc is installed on the side face of the rope wheel, the shell is installed on the connecting plate and provided with a space enabling the outer connecting disc to rotate, and a steel wire rope is wound around a wheel groove of the rope wheel and wheel grooves of the two transition wheels. According to the invention, collaborative optimization of topological configuration and high power density driving is realized, and balance of light weight and large torque output is realized.
source_title: Hip joint exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a passive exoskeleton robot assisted by a shoulder joint. The passive exoskeleton robot comprises a back plate, a waist plate, a back rod assembly, arm assemblies and power-assisted joint assemblies, wherein the back plate and the waist plate provide ergonomic support for the back and the waist of a wearer, the back rod assembly is used for connecting the back plate and thewaist plate, and the back rod assembly, the back plate and the waist plate jointly form a bionic spine mechanism based on human engineering, the arm assemblies are fixed to the rear portion of the back plate and comprise at least one unilateral-arm assemblies used for supporting the power-assisted joint assemblies and effectively transmitting arm loads to the back, the power-assisted joint assemblies are connected with the tail end of the arm assemblies in an embracing mode, and auxiliary torque used for gravity compensation is generated to support the arm load of the wearer. According to thepassive exoskeleton robot, through the design of the power-assisted joint assemblies, the flexible output capacity of super-large auxiliary torque is achieved, the proper auxiliary torque can be output at any working angle, sudden change or impact is avoided, and the output torque is improved by several times compared with an existing exoskeleton of the same type.
source_title: Passive exoskeleton robot assisted by shoulder joint

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot trajectory planning method based on human body parameters and states, and relates to the technical field of trajectory planning. Comprising the steps of collecting gait data of healthy individuals, generating a standard gait database, and complementing gait data of special individuals; in the early rehabilitation stage of the patient, an adaptive joint angle track is generated according to the standard gait track and the adjustment coefficient; after the patient has certain muscle ability, the gait track is adjusted in real time in a mode of combining off-line planning and on-line adjustment; and when the patient is judged to have the complete gait ability through the quantitative evaluation index, the exoskeleton provides assisting power at a specific phase of a gait cycle, and bottom layer servo control adopts a force control mode. By designing the shoulder joint angle limiting device, the rotation angle of the shoulder is effectively limited, arms are prevented from making contact with the chest of the human body in the rotation process, and therefore the safety of a user is greatly improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot trajectory planning method based on human body parameters and states

abstract: The invention discloses a walking aid exoskeleton cooperative control device based on a CPG network and a control method of the walking aid exoskeleton cooperative control device. The control device comprises an angle acquisition component, a CPG network component and a gait mutation recognizer. The angle acquisition component acquires angles of hip joints, knee joints and naked joints of a wearer; the CPG network component comprises three CPG network units, the three CPG network units respectively acquire angles of a hip joint, a knee joint and a naked joint of a wearer, and gait curve self-adaptive iteration is carried out through an internal oscillator to generate and output tracking human body joint angle data; the gait mutation recognizer is connected with the CPG network component and the angle acquisition component and performs correlation analysis on human joint angle data and angle data of the angle acquisition component, and the CPG network component and the gait mutation recognizer are connected with a driver of the walking-aid exoskeleton robot and control the driver according to the human joint angle data. The method has the advantages that the method has the advantage of predicting all-phase space, and the problems of insufficient adaptability and robustness can be solved.
source_title: Walking-aid exoskeleton cooperative control device based on CPG network and control method of walking-aid exoskeleton cooperative control device

abstract: A wearable robot device includes a frame, a detector provided on the frame for collecting information on a force applied from a user, a controller for determining a required amount of torque necessary for an operation of the wearable robot device based on the information collected by the detector, and for determining a sound corresponding to the required amount of torque, and an output unit for outputting the determined sound.
source_title: Wearable robot device and method of controlling the wearable robot device

abstract: The invention relates to an early warning device and an early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of an exoskeleton robot, and relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robot safety, on one hand, the invention discloses the early warning device for dynamic edge clamping control of the exoskeleton robot, the early warning device is arranged at a joint position of the exoskeleton robot, and the early warning device comprises a plurality of sensors and a controller, the acquisition module is used for acquiring multiple parameters of a joint position in real time; the edge calculation unit is used for setting a dynamic early warning interval corresponding to each parameter in advance, receiving the parameters of all the sensors in real time, and comparing the plurality of parameters with the respective dynamic early warning intervals; and the buzzer is used for giving an alarm. The invention further discloses an early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of the exoskeleton robot. According to the early warning device and the early warning method, accurate early warning is carried out on the sensor data in a dynamic edge card control mode, and the accuracy and the safety are greatly improved.
source_title: Early warning device and early warning method for dynamic edge clamping control of exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of wearable equipment, and particularly relates to a flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot which comprises a pressure sensing shoe, an assistance measuring device, a shank bandage, a longitudinal bandage, a thigh bandage, a flexible tension rope, a waist flexible wearable garment, a control driving system, a power transmission system and aposture sensing module. The control driving system excites the power transmission system, force is transmitted to the assistance measuring device along the flexible tension rope, and power assistanceof the ankle joint is conducted according to the sole pressure and the gait of a wearer. According to the flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot, the defects that a common exoskeleton power-assisted robot is large in inertia, poor in wearing comfort, short in endurance time and the like are overcome, and the flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot is light in overall weight,convenient to wear, good in comfort and fitness, high in power-assisted efficiency and capable of adapting to different terrains such as flat ground, soil, gravel, stairs and slopes.
source_title: Flexible wearable ankle joint power-assisted robot

abstract: The lower limb assisting exoskeleton robot comprises two sets of skeleton modules which are oppositely arranged, each skeleton module comprises a mounting frame and a skeleton structure arranged at the bottom of the mounting frame, each skeleton module further comprises a waist limiting structure, and each waist limiting structure comprises a front waist limiting rod and a side waist limiting rod; the front waist limiting rods are installed on the front side frame bodies of the corresponding installation frames, the front waist limiting rods of the two skeleton modules extend oppositely till the cantilever ends of the front waist limiting rods are close to each other, and the side waist limiting rods are connected to the corresponding front waist limiting rods and extend towards the rear sides of the front waist limiting rods. The positions of the side waist limiting rods on the corresponding front waist limiting rods are adjustable, and the adjusting direction is parallel to the axial direction of the front waist limiting rods. The waist of an operator can be reliably restrained and protected, the situations of shaking, instability and the like of the operator due to factors such as incoordination of the lower limbs and the upper body are reduced, then the situations of falling and the like of the operator are reduced, and the safety of electric power high-altitude operation is improved.
source_title: Lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot for electric power high-altitude operation

abstract: Disclosed is a lower limb exoskeleton robot. The lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a left leg exoskeleton, a right leg exoskeleton and a hip width adjustable assembly; the left leg exoskeleton and the right leg exoskeleton are symmetrically installed on the left side and the right side of the hip width adjustable assembly respectively; each of the left leg exoskeleton and the right leg exoskeleton comprises a thigh rod piece, a shank rod piece, a hip joint actuator, a knee joint actuator and a pedal plate; the thigh rod piece is in linkage with the hip joint actuator; the knee joint actuator is installed at the tail end of the thigh rod piece; the shank rod piece is fixedly installed on the knee joint actuator; and the shank rod piece is in linkage with rotation output of the knee joint actuator. The invention provides the lower limb exoskeleton robot which aims at improving the body type adaptability and interaction comfort in the wearing process.
source_title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The adjustable suspension support comprises a suspension support body, a fixing block, two connecting plates and the exoskeleton robot, the fixing block is located on the front side of the suspension support body, the two connecting plates are located on the left side and the right side of the fixing block respectively, and the front sides of the connecting plates are fixedly connected with the rear side of the exoskeleton robot. A containing groove is formed in an inner cavity of the fixing block, and a positioning mechanism used in cooperation with the exoskeleton robot is arranged in an inner cavity of the containing groove. Through cooperative use of the suspension bracket, the fixing block, the connecting plate, the exoskeleton robot, the placement groove, the positioning mechanism and the transmission mechanism, the problem that in the existing use process, if the leg length of the exoskeleton robot is large, the leg length of the exoskeleton robot needs to be shortened, so that the leg length of the exoskeleton robot can be matched with the suspension bracket, and the use cost is reduced is solved. And therefore, the problem that a user cannot conveniently adapt the exoskeleton robot to a suspension bracket for use is solved.
source_title: Adjustable suspension bracket for suspending exoskeleton robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A wearable robot for assisting muscular strength is provided to have a foot link which minimizes pressure on the ankle of a wearer even though the ankle joint part of the robot is formed as a manual joint. CONSTITUTION: A wearable robot for assisting muscular strength includes a waist wearing part which is worn at the waist part of a wear; a leg supporting part which assists the movement of the femoral region or shin of the wearer; and a foot link(160) which is combined with one end of the leg supporting part and is worn at the foot of the wearer. The foot link includes a foot combining member(161) which is combined with the leg supporting part; a foot frame(162) which is extended from the foot combining member; a foot supporting member(163) which is formed in order to contact with the ground when the wearer stands; and a footwear fixing part(164) which is combined with the footwear of the wearer.
source_title: Wearable robot to assist muscular strength

abstract: The invention relates to a passive energy feedback driving device for a rehabilitation robot. The passive energy feedback driving device comprises a right frame, a left frame, a bottom plate, a moving column, a partition plate, a one-way piece, a positioning shaft and a connecting line. Positioning holes are formed in the bottom plate, and the right frame, the left frame and the partition plate are connected and positioned with the bottom plate through matching of the shafts and the positioning holes to form a left channel, a right channel, an upper through opening and a lower through opening. A one-way piece hole is formed in one side of the partition plate, and the one-way piece is arranged in the one-way piece hole, so that the movable column can move in the left channel in a two-way mode and can only move in the right channel in a one-way mode. The one-way piece is composed of a connecting piece and a rotating piece, and a protruding part is arranged in the connecting piece to limit the rotating angle of the rotating piece. The moving column is connected with the connecting line, the connecting line can drive the moving column to move in the left channel and the right channel, and the moving column cannot pass through the upper through opening and the lower through opening. The device further comprises a bottom plate, a take-up bearing and a connecting wire. The take-up bearing is arranged on the bottom plate, the connecting wire is connected into the take-up bearing, the take-up bearing is provided with a built-in spring, and when the connecting wire is pulled out, the connecting wire can be automatically taken up. Through the passive energy feedback driving device, the problem that a passive driving exoskeleton is not fixed when the opportunities for collecting energy and feeding back energy are different can be solved, the energy consumption of a system is reduced, and the purposes of improving the movement efficiency of a human body and promoting the rehabilitation of motor nerves of the human body are achieved.
source_title: Passive energy feedback driving device for rehabilitation robot

abstract: A hand exoskeleton device is provided having at least three robotic units. One is for attachment to the thumb and has two elements for attachment to the distal and proximal phalanges. The other two each have three elements, for attachment to the distal, middle and proximal phalanges of the index and middle fingers. The elements of each robotic unit are interconnected by suitable hardware to provide for relative angular movement of the elements about an axis of rotation that corresponds substantially to the axis of rotation of a user's interphalangeal joint movement. An actuator is associated with the interconnecting hardware to enable adjustment of the two elements in each of two opposite directions. A sensor senses the angular position or force of one element relative to the other element of each pair. A computerized controller controls movement of the elements of each pair by means of the associated actuator.
source_title: HAND EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot leg mechanism. The exoskeleton robot leg mechanism comprises a hip joint module, a thigh extension module, a knee joint module, a calf extension module and an ankle joint module, wherein two ends of the thigh extension module are rotationally connected with the hip joint module and the knee joint module; and two ends of the calf extension module are rotationally connected with the knee joint module and the ankle joint module. The exoskeleton robot leg mechanism adopts a detachable combination mode, and is convenient in installation and disassembly; and the thigh extension module and the calf extension module capable of continuously adjusting the lengths enable a lower limb exoskeleton robot to adapt to wearing by different crowds, and the leg height of the robot can be adjusted according to persons with different heights to achieve comfortable wearing.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot leg mechanism

abstract: Disclosed herein is a wearable robot with improved operability and mobility through improvement of the upper limb structure thereof. The wearable robot includes an upper limb muscular power assist device to perform an articulation motion with a predetermined degree of freedom, the upper limb muscular power assist device being wearable by a user, and a mobile platform connected to the upper limb muscular power assist device to move according to information regarding movement speed and movement direction of the user in a rolling fashion. Consequently, mobility of the wearable robot and operation efficiency of the user are improved.
source_title: Wearable robot and control method thereof

abstract: PURPOSE: A method and a system for removing the disturbance of wearable robots are provided to correctly deliver the movement intention of a wearer to the robot to be strong in outdoor noise and the disturbance and to expect the correct output relative to the input. CONSTITUTION: A method and a system for removing the disturbance of wearable robots comprises the following steps: calculating request torque to be inputted in a robot joint from the difference of a target angular velocity value of the wearable robot and a current angular velocity value; reversely calculating expected input torque from the current angular velocity value, estimating it, and calculating disturbance torque by removing real input torque from the expected input torque; and calculating real input torque by removing the disturbance from the request torque.
source_title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ELIMINATING DISTURBANCE OF ROBOT

abstract: The present invention relates to a hydraulic system for supplying a hydraulic pressure so as to operate a wearable robot, which comprises: a tank unit; a first hydraulic pump unit and a second hydraulic pump unit, arranged at the left and right tank respectively so as to supply the actuator of the wearable robot by sucking each hydraulic oil from the tank; a connection unit for connecting to the actuator for the hydraulic oil sucked from the tank unit operated by at least one of the operations of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit; a first servo motor unit, arranged at the left and right side of the tank, and arranged at each upper portion of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit so as to operate the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit respectively; and a hydraulic control unit to control a first servo motor and a second servo motor, wherein at least one of the first hydraulic pump unit and the second hydraulic pump unit is to be operated so as to supply hydraulic oil of the tank unit to the connection unit, and to control the connection unit so as to connect the hydraulic oil supplying to the connection unit then to the actuator. To this end, the present invention, compared to the high power of the motor, can reduce the risk of damage affecting the human body when a trouble occurs, and the load can be distributed by the distributed placement of the motor so that the burden of design considering the center of gravity can be reduced.
source_title: Hydraulic system

abstract: An exoskeleton lower limb is provided with an upper connecting end, a leg motion device and a foot connecting device. The upper connecting end is used for receiving loads borne by the upper body of a user. The leg motion device is provided with a first body and a second body. The first body and the upper connecting end are hinged through a first hinged portion. The first body and the second body have relative linear motion. The foot connecting device is worn on the foot of the user and is hinged to the second body through a second hinged portion. The relative linear motion is in the direction of the connecting line between the first hinged portion and the second hinged portion. A wearable robot is provided with a carrying device and exoskeleton lower limbs arranged on the two legs of the user correspondingly. The carrying device is worn on the upper body of the user and is connected with upper connecting ends. The exoskeleton lower limb and the wearable robot are high in adaptive ability and good in motion flexibility.
source_title: Exoskeleton lower limb and wearable robot

abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system suitable for a complex terrain of a coal mine tunnel. The self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system comprises an exoskeleton main body, a load-bearing assembly and a gravity center adjusting assembly, the exoskeleton main body comprises a lower limb connecting area and a waist and back connecting area which are connected with each other; the load-bearing assembly comprises a box body, a weighing sensor and a load-bearing plate; a storage cavity capable of being opened and closed is formed in the box body; the bearing plate is arranged in the storage cavity and is arranged on the weighing sensor; the weighing sensor is used for measuring the load value of the bearing plate; a low-friction piece is arranged on the periphery of the bearing plate. In the scheme, the low-friction piece can reduce the friction force between the periphery of the bearing plate and the inner wall of the storage cavity, so that the influence of the friction force on the weighing precision of the weighing sensor is reduced. Due to the fact that the weighing precision of the weighing sensor can directly affect the gravity center adjusting precision of the gravity center adjusting assembly, the gravity center adjusting precision of the exoskeleton after load bearing can be improved by arranging the low-friction piece.
source_title: Self-adaptive load-bearing exoskeleton robot system suitable for complex terrain of coal mine tunnel

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton power-assisted robot. The exoskeleton power-assisted robot comprises a carry-on-the-back mechanism (10) used for being worn on a human body (200), a bearing mechanism (20) which is used for bearing goods and extends in the horizontal direction, two mechanical legs (40) which are connected to the rear end of the bearing mechanism (20), and two sets of driving mechanisms (30) which are installed on the bearing mechanism (20), wherein the front end of the bearing mechanism (20) is connected with the carry-on-the-back mechanism (10), and the driving mechanisms(30) correspond to the mechanical legs (40) in a one-to-one mode and are used for driving the mechanical legs (40) to walk. The provided exoskeleton power-assisted robot has high load capacity and can adapt to complex and changeable environments.
source_title: Exoskeleton power-assisted robot

abstract: The invention discloses an assisting exoskeleton hip joint structure. A waist main body structure and hip joint structures symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the waist main body structure respectively are disposed, dual-hole structures of a right waist structure member and hip joint pinboard are internally provided with movement connection shafts respectively, the ends of the two movementconnection shafts are fixedly provided with a hip-joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism and a hip-joint power mechanism respectively, and the hip joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism and the hip joint power mechanism are connected into a whole part through connection fixing pieces; the lower end of the hip-joint inward and outward stretching movement mechanism isprovided with thigh outer pipes used for being connected with exoskeleton leg knee parts, multi-degree-of-freedom type rigidity-flexibility-combined structures of the hip, knee and ankle joints are achieved, and fitting of the movement state of human joints can be achieved to a greater degree; it is ensured that the joints of an exoskeleton can have highly dynamic characteristics under a compactspace, output power can be precisely controlled, flexible interaction between the structure and the human body can be achieved, unexpected force impact under an uncertain external environment is handled, and the body of a robot is protected.
source_title: Assisting exoskeleton hip joint structure

abstract: The invention discloses a portable elbow exoskeleton robot, comprising a mechanical flexible support, an elastic elbow sleeve, a sensing system and a control system. The mechanical flexible support isput on the elastic elbow sleeve along the length of the elastic elbow sleeve; the sensing system is arranged at one end of the elastic elbow sleeve; the control system is arranged on the elastic elbow sleeve; the output end of the sensing system is connected to the input end of the control system. The portable elbow exoskeleton robot has the advantages that the mechanical flexible support has multiple degrees of freedom, the demand of an elbow for degrees of freedom in different directions during moving can be met, and the portable elbow exoskeleton robot is light in weight and convenient tocarry.
source_title: Portable elbow exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a self-adaptive power-assisted control method for a waist exoskeleton robot, which is characterized in that a hierarchical control system is designed, and an upper-layer parameter generator generates parameters of a complete power-assisted state mode in a middle-layer finite-state machine according to waist buckling angle values and plantar pressure values when different wearers bend down at the lowest points; the middle-layer finite-state machine sets four state modes according to the bending and stretching angles and angular speeds of the waist and back of the human body and the plantar pressure, all the modes can be effectively switched, and the four state modes send different control parameters to the bottom-layer force-position hybrid controller. The force-position hybrid controller can realize single or hybrid control of force positions of the exoskeleton actuator. According to the control method, the characteristics of the working process of the man-machine compatible waist assistance exoskeleton are fully considered, implementation is easy and convenient, assistance parameters can be adjusted in a personalized mode according to the actual operation conditions of different individuals, and the control state diversity and man-machine coordination of the waist assistance exoskeleton are greatly improved.
source_title: Self-adaptive power-assisted control method for waist exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a backpack upper limb exoskeleton and a shoulder joint coordinated movement tracking design method thereof, the backpack upper limb exoskeleton comprises a strap base, a shoulder joint module, a big arm joint module and a small arm joint module, the shoulder joint module comprises a first drive, a second drive, a first joint, a second joint and a third joint; the first joint is connected to the strap base, and the first drive is arranged between the first joint and the strap base; the second joint is connected to the first joint, and the second drive is arranged between the first joint and the second joint; the third joint is connected to the second joint, the big arm joint module comprises a big arm drive, and the big arm drive is rotationally connected to the third joint; and a synchronous transmission mechanism is arranged among the second joint, the third joint and the big arm driver. The six-degree-of-freedom exoskeleton robot is applied to the field of exoskeletons, five shoulders and one elbow of a person can be tracked only through five drives, the number of the drives is reduced, the weight is reduced, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.
source_title: Backpack upper limb exoskeleton and shoulder joint coordinated movement tracking design method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses an invisible adjustable human body electric power-assisted exoskeleton, and belongs to the technical field of bionic machinery and wearable equipment. The device adopts an innovative knee motor-free design, power-assisted output is realized through a waist motor driving unit and a flexible transmission structure, the legs are completely hidden in the trousers during wearing, and high invisibility is realized. The core innovation of the robot includes that the design of the multi-degree-of-freedom movable joints supports complex actions such as lateral movement and going up and down stairs; the lengths of the thighs and the shanks can be adjusted to adapt to users with different heights; the intelligent control system provides an automatic mode, a foot feeling mode, a slow walking mode and a fast walking mode and supports stepless speed regulation. Real-time gait recognition based on a leg sensor ensures natural and smooth man-machine coordination. The problems that a traditional exoskeleton is heavy, conspicuous and stiff in joint are effectively solved, and the exoskeleton has remarkable application value in the fields of medical rehabilitation and military operation and has the advantages of concealment and movement flexibility.
source_title: Human body electric power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: A mesofluidic powered robotic and/or prosthetic finger joint includes a first finger section having at least one mesofluidic actuator in fluid communication with a first actuator, a second mesofluidic actuator in fluid communication with a second actuator and a second prosthetic finger section pivotally connected to the first finger section by a joint pivot, wherein the first actuator pivotally cooperates with the second finger to provide a first mechanical advantage relative to the joint point and wherein the second actuator pivotally cooperates with the second finger section to provide a second mechanical advantage relative to the joint point.
source_title: MESOFLUIDIC CONTROLLED ROBOTIC OR PROSTHETIC FINGER

abstract: The exoskeleton robot comprises an auxiliary assembly, the auxiliary assembly comprises a mounting frame, two sets of first driving joints are mounted on the outer wall of the mounting frame and symmetrically mounted on the two sides of the mounting frame correspondingly, and second driving arms are mounted through the first driving joints; the second driving arm is of a two-section split type design. By arranging the auxiliary assembly, after the battery is installed, a limiting fixing groove of the auxiliary assembly can be clamped through a limiting clamping block for limiting and fixing, the situation that normal energy supply is affected due to unnecessary sliding displacement of the battery in the using process is avoided, and the battery can be rapidly disassembled by shifting the limiting clamping block to relieve limiting and fixing of the battery when disassembly is needed; according to the technical scheme, traditional bolt type fixing is not needed, the mounting and dismounting speed can be effectively increased, the mounting and dismounting convenience is improved, the efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the use convenience is greatly improved, and the use comfort can be improved.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot control system capable of enabling a user to wirelessly control the driving condition of a wearable robot using a mobile communication terminal such as a smartphone or a tablet PC. According to the present invention, the wearable robot control system makes a technical feature of including a wearable robot unit for generating mechanical power and for sensing the movement of the user; and a user terminal unit for transmitting a driving control signal to the wearable robot unit and for receiving the driving sensing signal of the wearable robot unit.
source_title: CONTROL SYSTEM FOR WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a composite identification method for kinetic parameters of an industrial robot. The method comprises the following steps: establishing an industrial robot kinetic model and carrying out linearization processing; a five-order Fourier series is adopted as an excitation track of the industrial robot; controlling the industrial robot to move according to the designed excitation track, and sampling joint torque and joint angle information to obtain observation torque and an observation matrix; based on the industrial robot kinetic equation and the observation data, kinetic parameters of the industrial robot are obtained through identification by using a least square method; and compensating the friction torque through the BP neural network. According to the method, the excitation trajectory is designed into the five-order Fourier series, so that the influence of interference factors such as noise on the observation data set is effectively reduced, and the precision of the observation data set is greatly improved; the friction torque is compensated through the friction model obtained by training the BP neural network, so that the deviation of the predicted friction torque is effectively reduced, and the identification accuracy of the dynamic parameters of the industrial robot is improved.
source_title: Industrial robot kinetic parameter composite identification method

abstract: To provide an industrial robot, correcting hanging-down of the tip of a fork to easily, quickly and precisely convey a conveyed material without any increase in thickness even if the fork is long. The fork 16 is removably fitted to a hand 15 by a bolt 17. The hand 15 is provided with a fork tip position adjusting means 20 composed of a shim 21 and a shim presser 22 which are abutted on the lower surface of the fork 16 to push up the tip side of the fork 16. The shims 21 of various thicknesses are previously provided, and the shim having such a thickness that the tip of the fork 16 is substantially equal to the base end is selected and used.
source_title: INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a composite fixture used for an industrial robot. The composite fixture used for the industrial robot comprises an arm, wherein clamping buckles are respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of the arm, a socket is formed on the outer surface of the bottom of the arm, and is electrically connected with an action command terminal of the robot, thebottom end of the arm is fixedly connected with a base, locking buckles are respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side, close to the arm, of the upper surface of the base, asucking disc is fixedly connected with the interior of the base, the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed block, and clamping slots are formed in the bottom and one side surface of thefixed block respectively. The composite fixture used for the industrial robot has the advantages that adsorption and grabbing of a large-size object and adsorption of the fixed block are realized byarranging the sucking disc; the fixed block is further fixed by arranging the locking buckles and combining the sucking disc; the fixture can be conveniently replaced by arranging corresponding clamping slots and clamping blocks as well as a fixing lock; and multiple work types of machines can be fixed at the bottom of each clamping block, so that the aim that multiple fixtures are integrated intoa whole is realized.
source_title: Composite fixture used for industrial robot

abstract: The invention relates to a planning method for smooth transition between linear tracks of a self-driven articulated arm measuring machine. Pose information and the constraint conditions are input into an acceleration and deceleration algorithm and an arc transition model to obtain a transition trajectory, and the transition trajectory is combined with a linear trajectory to obtain a complete measurement trajectory. The angle, the speed and the angular speed of each joint are obtained by means of inverse kinematics and an inverse Jacobian matrix, joint space quintic polynomial interpolation is carried out at the abrupt change position of the speed, the continuity and smoothness of the speed and the acceleration are ensured, the self-driven articulated arm measuring machine is prevented from being impacted by the abrupt change of the speed and the acceleration, and the measuring precision is improved. According to the planning method, high-precision measurement of the self-driven articulated arm measuring machine can be realized, and the method can also be applied to trajectory planning of an industrial robot.
source_title: Planning method for smooth transition between linear tracks of self-driven articulated arm measuring machine

abstract: The invention discloses a data monitoring device for industrial robot machine vision, which adopts monitoring equipment, a contraction control mechanism and a hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing execution mechanism, and is characterized in that the contraction control mechanism is connected between the monitoring equipment and the hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing execution mechanism; and the monitoring equipment moves upwards and retracts into the contraction control mechanism, and meanwhile, when the monitoring equipment retracts into the contraction control mechanism, the hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing executing mechanism is controlled to move downwards so as to block the hydraulic oil pipe, and the hydraulic oil pipe is forced to stop working. According to the invention, the contraction control mechanism is adopted to effectively protect the monitoring equipment, the phenomenon of hard contact between the monitoring equipment and a product is avoided, and the monitoring equipment is effectively protected for the first time; meanwhile, a hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing executing mechanism is adopted to block a hydraulic oil pipe, the hydraulic oil pipe is forced to stop working, the industrial robot is controlled to stop working, and monitoring equipment is effectively protected for the second time; the automation degree is high, working efficiency is improved, and labor cost is reduced.
source_title: Data monitoring device for industrial robot machine vision

abstract: PURPOSE: A surgical robot system and a control method thereof are provided to smoothly perform an operation by displaying a virtual surgical instrument and an actual surgical instrument using augmented reality. CONSTITUTION: A surgical robot system comprises a master robot(1) and a slave robot(2). The master robot controls the slave robot remotely. The master robot comprises a storage unit, an augmented reality implementation unit(350), and an operation signal generator(340). The augmented reality implementation unit stores the user operation history for a virtual operation in the storage unit as the history information. A manipulation signal generator generates an operation signal using surgical history information and transmits the operation signal to the slave robot according to the application command.
source_title: SURGICAL ROBOT SYSTEM USING HISTORY INFORMATION AND CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The invention provides a safety control method for position and torque alternation of a man-machine cooperation collision scene, and belongs to the field of industrial robots, and the method comprises the steps: S1, under a normal condition, enabling a robot to perform trajectory tracking in a position control mode, and continuously correcting a position error; s2, collision detection is conducted through a sliding mode control algorithm, and when a collision signal is detected, it is judged that the robot collides with the outside; s3, when it is detected that the robot collides, the robot is switched to a torque control mode, and an active buffering mechanism is started; s4, detecting whether the robot stops collision or not, if not, executing a torque mode, performing speed detection and torque detection, and starting a protection mechanism; if so, executing the step S5; and S5, when the robot is separated from the impact surface, the robot automatically returns to the position control mode and waits for standby. According to the invention, the safety and performance of the industrial robot working in the same space as people can be improved.
source_title: Safety control method for position and moment alternation of man-machine cooperation collision scene

abstract: The invention relates to a multi-DOF sensor for an industrial robot, which robot has at least two DOF. The multi-DOF sensor is arranged for sensing at least one force and is constituted by a plurality of one-DOF sensors (11, 12). A first end face of each one-DOF sensor (11, 12) is connected to a surface of a first body (31 a, 31 b) and a second end face of each one-DOF sensor (11, 12) is connected to a surface of a second body. The invention also relates to an industrial robot comprising the invented multi-DOF sensor.
source_title: A MULTI-DOF SENSOR FOR AN INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses an automatic assembly production line of an industrial robot joint, the industrial robot joint comprises a shell, a speed reducer and a plurality of parts, and the automatic assembly production line comprises a first-stage line body, a second-stage line body and a third-stage line body which are in butt joint in sequence; wherein the first-stage line body is used for feeding a shell; the secondary line body is used for assembling the speed reducer and the shell to obtain a semi-finished joint product; and the third-stage line body is used for mounting a plurality of parts on the joint semi-finished product according to a preset mounting rule so as to obtain a joint finished product, and discharging the joint finished product. According to the technical scheme, the joints of the industrial robot are assembled in an automatic mode, compared with a manual assembly mode, the production efficiency of the joints of the industrial robot is greatly improved, the large-batch and high-quality production requirements of manufacturers can be met, and the production benefits are greatly improved.
source_title: Automatic assembly production line and method for industrial robot joints and storage medium

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses an industrial robot control device and system based on control integration, and the device and system are characterized inthat a teaching control integration module is connected with a driving module and is used for controlling a robot body in real time and carrying out man-machine interaction; the driving module is usedfor driving the robot body. A control command is sent to the robot body through a key or a touch screen; when the control command is received, and manual and automatic related operation control overthe robot can be completed; a step of feeding back the state data is carried out, and the state of the robot is displayed by using the touch screen. The invention provides the handheld robot control device which is low in cost, high in performance and easy to operate. According to the invention, a real-time control function is added to a traditional demonstrator unit, so that the demonstrator hasteaching and control functions, an independent controller is reduced, the size of a control box is reduced, and normal operation experience is ensured under the condition of providing the same functional performance.
source_title: Industrial robot control device and system based on control integration

abstract: This method allows, by associating an imprecise low-range power actuator 5 with an actuator 3 of low power in comparison with the first, the play of the power actuator to be taken up to ensure good quality positioning 1 by acting on one and the same articulation 2. The method according to the invention can be applied to mechanical systems where good precision in the positioning of a spindle is required (manipulation arm, industrial robot spindle). <IMAGE>
source_title: Method for fine-positioning articulated systems by the association of actuators of different powers

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, and discloses a mobile station for sleeving a protective sleeve, and the mobile station comprises a base which can move relative to the ground; the at least one sleeving arm is arranged on the base; the actuator is arranged at the tail end of at least one sleeving arm and used for keeping the opening of the protective sleeve; and the control device is connected with the base and the at least one sleeving arm and is configured to obtain the pose of at least one part of the surgical robot, generate an actuator movement path for the actuator based on the pose of at least one part of the surgical robot and control the base and/or the at least one sleeving arm to move, and the protective sleeve is sleeved on at least one part of the surgical robot by the actuator along the movement path of the actuator.
source_title: Mobile station for sleeving protective sleeve and robot system

abstract: The OLED screen automatic assembling equipment based on robot operation comprises an assembling line, the assembling line comprises a bottom plate, the two ends of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with outer supporting plates correspondingly, and an upper feeding mechanism is installed on one side of the top end of each outer supporting plate and fixedly connected with a transmission belt correspondingly; the two sides of the top end of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with inner supporting plates respectively, the top ends of the inner supporting plates are fixedly connected with lower feeding mechanisms respectively, the two ends of each lower feeding mechanism are fixedly connected with transmission belts respectively, the two ends of the bottom of each lower feeding mechanism are slidably clamped with guide sliding grooves respectively, and the guide sliding grooves are formed in the opposite end faces of the inner supporting plates respectively. The center of the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a bearing plate used for jacking materials, and the transmission belt drives the upper feeding mechanism and the lower feeding mechanism to synchronously and oppositely move or synchronously and reversely move. According to the assembly line, the OLED screens are pasted and assembled, overall automatic operation is achieved, manual participation is reduced, and the assembly efficiency is improved.
source_title: OLED screen automatic assembling equipment based on robot operation

abstract: The invention provides a building construction carrying industrial robot, and belongs to the technical field of building machinery, the building construction carrying industrial robot comprises a frame, a carrying assembly and moving assemblies, and the carrying assembly is arranged on the frame; a plurality of moving assemblies are arranged; each moving assembly comprises a first supporting leg with one end movably connected with the frame, a second supporting leg movably connected with the other end of the first supporting leg, and a roller assembly arranged at the end, away from the first supporting leg, of the second supporting leg. According to the building construction carrying industrial robot provided by the invention, the moving assembly has two motion modes. And in the actual operation process, the moving modes can be switched at any time according to different terrains, and the trafficability of the building construction carrying industrial robot in the complex terrain environment is improved.
source_title: Building construction carrying industrial robot

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot with a gear backlash adjuster, comprising a base. The upper end of the base is symmetrically provided with a plurality of threaded holes; a box is fixedly connected to the upper end of the base; a shell is welded to the upper end of the box; a driving mechanism is arranged in the box. The industrial robot has the advantages that elasticity of powerful springs and pull of pull springs enable a connection gear, a driving gear and a driven gear to effectively engage together even when abraded, so that backlashes are avoided; a handle can be rotated to adjust the position of the connection gear, thereby decreasing the backlashes between the connection gear and the driving gear and driven gear, and preventing the problem that insufficient elasticity of the powerful springs and insufficient pull of the pull springs cause failure of elimination of gear backlashes; an observation hole helps a worker to perform maintaining conveniently, so that the worker can adjust the backlashes more precisely.
source_title: Industrial robot with gear backlash adjuster

abstract: The invention discloses a wireless automatic inspection robot for a mine belt conveyor. The wireless automatic inspection robot comprises a support plate, and connecting plates are fixedly arranged onthe two sides of two ends of the support plate. A support device is fixedly arranged under the end, far away from the support plate, of each connecting plate. A sliding rod is fixedly arranged underthe support plate, and a sliding block is glidingly arranged on the outer wall of the sliding rod in a sleeved mode. A driving device is arranged on the sliding block, and a box is fixedly arranged under the sliding block. A lithium battery, a safety barrier, a processor and a wireless bridge are arranged in the box, and a camera, an LED lamp and a smoke sensor are fixedly arranged under the box.The camera, the LED lamp, the smoke sensor and the wireless bridge are electrically connected with the processor. The wireless automatic inspection robot has the beneficial effects of realizing automatic inspection for the mine belt conveyor, reducing the labor intensity of inspection workers, improving the inspection efficiency, and increasing the safety performance of inspection.
source_title: Wireless automatic inspection robot for mine belt conveyor

abstract: The invention relates to an industrial robot health state evaluation method based on multi-modal servo information mapping. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining the influence of a complex service condition on the performance of an industrial robot and a degradation mechanism; health perception features are extracted from multi-mode servo information collected in the operation process of the industrial robot; according to the collected health perception characteristics, a health perception model of the industrial robot under the complex working condition is established; an incremental learning model is established, a degradation model is obtained along with continuous addition, continuous learning and updating of new data, failure time distribution of the degradation model is predicted, decision support is provided for maintenance of industrial robot equipment, and a multi-modal servo information mapping model is constructed by deeply analyzing a performance degradation mechanism of an industrial robot under complex working conditions. And accurate sensing of the health state of the robot is realized. And a self-supervised contrast representation learning theory is utilized to solve the problem of fault sample deficiency, and the accuracy of health perception is improved. Based on an incremental learning theory of multi-modal servo information, an autonomous diagnosis model is established, and rapid diagnosis and performance degradation prediction of a new fault are realized.
source_title: Industrial robot health state assessment method based on multi-modal servo information mapping

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot control system and method based on big data, and a mobile control platform and method based on an intelligent algorithm. An industrial robot equipment data acquisition assembly is arranged on a production line industrial robot to acquire equipment data of the industrial robot in different states and is used for detecting industrial robot equipment data when a product is close to the industrial robot, and the industrial robot equipment data is sent to a cloud super computing platform in an industrial robot monitoring and decision-making assembly; the industrial robot monitoring and decision-making assembly comprises a cloud super-computing platform, and the cloud super-computing platform is used for determining the machining relation between a product corresponding to the industrial robot equipment data and the industrial robot according to the industrial robot equipment data and sending the machining relation to the matched intelligent display screen; the control problem of an existing industrial robot can be solved.
source_title: Industrial robot control system and method based on big data

abstract: The invention discloses a cooperative scheduling method of an industrial robot scheduling system, and relates to the technical field of cooperative scheduling, and the method comprises the steps: recording each robot participating in a scheduling task as a target robot, and obtaining a path transmission quality imbalance coefficient, a queuing coefficient and a transmission signal attenuation coefficient between the target robot and other target robots; a communication delay coefficient is obtained according to the path transmission quality imbalance coefficient, the queuing coefficient and the transmission signal attenuation coefficient, and communication delays between the target robot and other target robots are divided into different grades by combining a preset threshold value; and different optimization measures are adopted according to different communication delay levels to assist the cooperative scheduling of the industrial robot scheduling system, so that the communication delay between the industrial robots can be detected and corrected, timely task coordination and no data distortion are ensured, the influence on the execution efficiency of the overall assembly task is reduced, and the efficiency of the whole assembly task is improved. The production line stability and the product quality are ensured.
source_title: Cooperative scheduling method of industrial robot scheduling system

abstract: The invention relates to an electrical drive (13) and an industrial robot (1) that comprises at least one such electrical drive (13), having: an electric motor (14) that comprises a motor housing (15), a drive shaft (18) rotatably mounted by means of at least two roller bearings (21, 22), a stator (16) secured in said motor housing (15), and a rotor (17) that is connected to said drive shaft (18) and can rotate in said motor housing (15); as well as a harmonic drive gear (19) that comprises a gear housing (20), a circular spline (23) with an inner toothing (24), a flex spline (25) that has an outer toothing (26), and a wave generator (27) that can be rotated in the gear housing (20) and that rolls on the flex spline (25), said outer toothing (26) of the flex spline (25) engaging with the inner toothing (24) of the circular spline (23) such that they become meshed as a function of a rotational movement of the wave generator (27). The rotor (17) is secured on the drive shaft (18), and a first of said at least two roller bearings (21, 22) is arranged inside the flex spline (25) and is designed to mount said drive shaft (18) such that it can rotate inside the gear housing (20).
source_title: ELECTRICAL DRIVE AND INDUSTRIAL ROBOT COMPRISING AT LEAST ONE SUCH ELECTRICAL DRIVE

abstract: The invention provides an industrial robot teaching programming system and method based on a 3D joystick. The industrial robot teaching programming system comprises the 3D joystick, a main controller, an industrial robot and a force sensor. The teaching programming process comprises the following steps. The method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a mapping relation between a 3D operating lever and the tail end of a mechanical arm of a corresponding industrial robot, and enabling the moving and rotating ranges of the 3D operating lever to be in one-to-one correspondence with the working range of the robot; s2, designing a position control ring based on contact force to realize stability of the contact force; s3, correcting accidental errors and personal errors in the teaching process; s4, operating a 3D control rod to change the pose of the industrial robot; s5, collecting a teaching track; s6, judging whether the teaching is finished or not; if not, continuing to operate for teaching, and if so, ending the teaching through a program, and carrying out the next operation; step S7, the teaching track is reproduced; the working state of the specific robot with any shaft linkage can be set, the universality is higher, and the robot is simpler and more convenient.
source_title: Industrial robot teaching programming system and method based on 3D joystick

abstract: The industrial robot assembly (10) has an industrial robot (12), with an emergency current loop (14), an emergency switch (16), and an emergency stop module (18). The emergency stop module has a current loop (20) with an emergency stop input (22) for the connection of the emergency stop switch. An industrial robot connection (24) connects the industrial robot current loop and an emergency stop module connection (26) for connecting another identical emergency stop module. An independent claim is also included for an industrial robot emergency stop module for an assembly.
source_title: Industrial robot assembly has industrial robot, with emergency current loop, emergency switch, and emergency stop module, which has current loop with emergency stop input for connection of emergency stop switch

abstract: Disclosed is an eating assistant robot using a conveyor. The eating assistant robot comprises: a plurality of trays which receives foods by size, which are cut in predetermined shapes and sizes and has an outlet port for allowing the foods to pass through; a discharging means for discharging the foods from the trays; a delivering means for transferring the foods discharged by the discharging means into a predetermined position; a robot arm which is coupled to the handle of a spoon at one end and loads the foods delivered by the delivering means on a food receiving part of the spoon; and an arm control unit which controls the robot arm and loads the foods delivered by the delivering means on the food receiving part of the spoon. The eating assisting robot is simply operated and is cheaply manufactured. [Reference numerals] (110) Tray;(120) Discharging means;(130) Delivering means;(140) Robot arm;(150) Arm control unit;(160) Control unit
source_title: Meal assistance robot using a conveyor

abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the shift control of an industrial robot with no temporary stop nor the collision against an obstacle, by securing a curve shift where a shift route decided from the synthesization of speed components of an optimum speed pattern has the smooth variation of speed according to the result of synthesization of the orthogonal components of a mobile plane. CONSTITUTION:For instance, mobile spots P0-P3 are supplied in the form of data. Then each distance among these spots is calculated, and the speed components are synthesized in terms of a mobile plane for independent coordinate axis directions, i.e., horizontal two axes and a vertical optimum speed pattern. Then shift speeds are calculated on a mobile route and at a prescribed spot on the mobile route. Based on these data, the shift of a robot is controlled. For the optimum speed pattern, an acceleration section (a) is equal to a curve part formed by synthesizing a sign curve immediately before the rise of the speed is linear and enters a fixed speed section (b) with these sections (a) and (b) and a deceleration section (c) in the axial direction and in a linear section between the spots P0 and P1. Then a curve is obtained with synthesization of the sign curve in the section (c) following the section (b). Thus a smooth end is secured with the robot shift.
source_title: SHIFT CONTROLLER OF INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: A robotic system employing a plurality of surgical robots (20) and a surgical procedure controller (22)for executing a surgical procedure on an anatomical structure (e.g., a heart) within an anatomical region(e.g., a thoracic region). In operation, controller (22) autonomously controls a navigation of each surgical robot (20) within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure by directing a navigation of each surgical robot (20) within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure based on a surgical plan for executing the surgical procedure on the anatomical structure (e.g., a convergent ablation plan consisting of an epicardial ablation plan for abating an exterior of a heart and an endocardial ablation plan for ablating an interior of the heart) and further by revising the surgical plan responsive to a partial or complete inability of one or more of the surgical robots (20) to be navigated within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure based on the surgical plan.
source_title: IMAGE GUIDED ROBOTIC CONVERGENT ABLATION

abstract: The invention provides a control method, device and equipment for robot constant-force deburring and a storage medium. Firstly, impedance characteristics of a workpiece to be machined are obtained, and a mapping model of the impedance characteristics and coordinate changes is established; thirdly, inputting the mapping model into a trained BP neural network to predict and generate a control signal for controlling a deburring end effector; then, the industrial robot is driven based on the control signal, and the real-time impedance characteristic detected by the deburring end effector is obtained in real time; and finally, according to the real-time impedance characteristic, attitude offset generated after rigid contact of the end effector is generated, and the attitude offset is compensated through a point position interpolation method. The problem that due to the fact that the feeding motion of an end effector possibly causes large extrusion acting force, the posture of a machining path deviates is solved.
source_title: Control method, device and equipment for robot constant-force deburring and storage medium

abstract: A robotic automated filling and capping system is made up of a cartridge infeed conveyor, a cap infeed conveyor, an outfeed conveyor, a six-axis robot, and a selective compliance articulated robot arm, all of which are configured to work together to automatically, and sanitarily, fill and cap vape oil cartridges.
source_title: ROBOTIC AUTOMATED FILLING AND CAPPING SYSTEM FOR VAPE OIL CARTRIDGES

abstract: The invention relates to a correction method for correcting conveyor tracking information, a correction system, and a storage medium, which can accurately set conveyor tracking information without stopping a conveyor. The correction method according to the present invention comprises the steps of: (a) temporarily setting conveyor tracking information; (b) acquiring a reference image, a first image, and a second image by capturing an image of a reference object carried on the conveyor at three capturing timings while the conveyor is moving at a fixed speed; (c) analyzing the three images to obtain measurement coordinate values of the reference position, the first position and the second position in the robot coordinate system; and (d) correcting the temporary setting value of the conveyor tracking information so as to match the position and action of the conveyor indicated by the conveyor tracking information with various measurement results.
source_title: Correction method and correction system for correcting tracking information of conveyor and storage medium

abstract: A method of controlling movements of an industrial robot (12) in relation to a surface (28), the method comprising providing a plurality of candidate target points (56a-56f) for the industrial robot in an offline programming system (14); providing a plurality of actual reference points (70; 70a-70e) in the offline programming system, the actual reference points being indicative of a true profile of the surface; modifying the candidate target points in the offline programming system based on the actual reference points to provide a plurality of modified target points (72; 72a-72f) for the industrial robot; providing a target robot program (52) for the industrial robot based on the modified target points; and executing the target robot program in a robot controller (16) to thereby cause the industrial robot to perform movements in relation to the surface.
source_title: METHOD OF CONTROLLING MOVEMENTS OF INDUSTRIAL ROBOT, AND ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a robot motion control method and device, electronic equipment and a medium.
